Apotheosis – Ascension to Godhood
Vol.1

Chapter 1
Dawn hasn't broken yet. The cold air of late autumn is still strong, and the surroundings are still pitch black.
In the cellar of the Luo family, an oil lamp has been quietly lit. The young man Luo Zheng covers most of the light from the oil lamp. He sits upright in front of the table and quietly takes out a worn-out thread-bound book.
Luo Zheng has just turned 17 this year. He is thin and can't be said to be handsome, but he has a gentle temperament. Especially his eyes, which are very spirited. Even under the dim light of the oil lamp, his eyes are still shining.
"It took me a month to finish reading this' Heaven's Inquisition of the Constitution '. The principles are all good, but I can't agree with the four words' requite evil with good '!" Luo Zheng whispers softly. Looking at the pea-sized flame, his face shows a sad expression: "If it weren't for my father's kindness, if he didn't believe in these four words, my family wouldn't have ended up like this, and my father wouldn't have died …"
After thinking for a long time, the sound of a lock being unlocked suddenly comes from the cellar door. Luo Zheng immediately dispels the sad expression in his eyes, and it is replaced by a face full of determination. At the same time, he nimbly blows out the oil lamp and covers himself with the worn-out quilt.
The cellar's lock is opened, and several footsteps come from afar. The person in the lead comes forward and steps on Luo Zheng's bed. He shouts with a sharp voice: "Are you still sleeping? Get up! Do you still think you're the young master of the Luo family? "
This person is a steward of the Luo family. He has a sharp mouth and monkey cheeks, and a tumor on his forehead. At first glance, he makes people feel disgusted.
Luo Zheng lifts the quilt and deliberately rubs his eyes. He climbs up from the bed and silently puts on his shoes, socks, and clothes. Although these clothes are worn-out, Luo Zheng still wears them meticulously and neatly.
The steward rolled his eyes and said, "Moral character." Then he waved his hand and several servants behind him surrounded Luo Zheng. They put on thick leather armor, handcuffs, and shackles on Luo Zheng's hands and feet.
After finishing this, Luo Zheng walked out of the cellar under the guidance of a servant and headed for the Luo Family's Drill Hall.
The Luo family was a big family in Chongming County. They owned thousands of acres of fertile land and hundreds of mines. They were famous in Chongming County.
However, there were over a thousand counties in the entire Eastern Region. Among them, there were countless Noble Clans. The Luo Clan was not ranked high in the entire Eastern Region.
Escorted by the servants, Luo Zheng crawled out of the gloomy cellar, passed through countless pavilions, terraces, pavilions, bridges, corridors and boats, and finally arrived at the entrance of the Drill Hall.
The Drill Hall was spacious. It was the place where the disciples of the Luo Family practiced. Dragons, phoenixes, and lions were carved with white marble at the entrance. The ground was paved with one-meter square black tortoise stones. Standing at the entrance of the Drill Hall, one could feel the grandeur of the hall.
In the middle of the Martial Arts Hall, dozens of grey-robed disciples of the Luo Family were practicing martial arts under the guidance of the Luo Family's instructor.
The wind from his fists blew, and he shouted again and again.
These disciples of the Luo Family were all in their teens. In order to fight for a certain status in the Luo Family, they studied diligently every day and practiced hard to refine their bodies.
The cold autumn wind was bone-chilling, but their bodies were sweating profusely. Some of them even had steam rising from their heads and white mist curling around them …
On one side of the Drill Hall, there were already more than a dozen men wearing leather armor and shackles on their hands and feet like Luo Zheng's. These men all had a weak aura. Their noses were bruised and their faces were swollen. There were wounds all over their bodies.
After being escorted into the Drill Hall, Luo Zheng stood with these men.
Most of these men with weak auras were prisoners on death row that the Luo Family bought from the local prison. They were bought back and became the slaves of the Luo Family. The purpose of these slaves was to act as human targets for the disciples of the Luo Family to beat, train and test their strength at will. These human targets were beaten to death every year. Who knew how many of them were crippled.
Luo Zheng was not a prisoner on death row that was bought back. He used to be the eldest son of the main branch of the Luo Family, the famous young master. He had a noble status in the Luo Family. When his peers met him, they had to salute him very respectfully. Even the elders of the family were polite to him.
However, two years ago, a major event happened in Chongyang County. Luo Zheng's father, the head of the Luo Family, was poisoned and plotted against by his own brothers. He suddenly died.
Then, the main branch was framed by the other three branches of the Luo Family. They were accused of betraying the family. Under the quarrel between the brothers, the main branch completely declined.
Luo Zheng, as the former young master, was also accused of betraying the family. He was reduced to a slave of the Luo Family and became a human target for the Luo Family. He was beaten by the disciples of the Luo Family to practice martial arts, never to rise again.
This kind of life of being beaten at will had already lasted for two years. In these two years, Luo Zheng had already suffered countless kicks and punches and suffered countless insults.
"Today's martial arts practice ends here. Disciples of the Luo Family, choose your own human target! Hitting the human body will allow you to fully comprehend the skills in actual combat, familiarize yourself with the weaknesses of the human body and the distribution of the bones! "
After the Luo Family's instructor gave the order, the disciples of the Luo Family each looked for their own human target. Soon, the Martial Arts Practice Hall was filled with cries and begging for mercy. These disciples of the Luo Family did not treat these slaves as human beings at all.
Many of them found Luo Zheng and beat him with more vigor and strength. This was because trampling on the former young master gave them a greater sense of accomplishment!
Facing the fists of the Luo Family disciples, Luo Zheng protected the vital parts of his body. His face was expressionless as he calmly responded. This … he was already used to it.
Not long after, a few people suddenly walked in from the entrance of the Martial Arts Practice Hall. The young man in the lead was wearing a brocade robe and was beaming with happiness.
"The young master is here!"
"Young master, you finally came out of seclusion. Looking at your refreshed spirit, you must have made great progress in your cultivation!"
"The young master is talented and intelligent. You are the genius of our Luo Family. You must have entered the Bone Refining Stage!"
The disciples of the Luo Family present stopped beating and talked to the young man in brocade robe one after another. Their flattery was overflowing from their faces.
Luo Zheng's eyes fell on the young man in brocade robe. An imperceptible anger quietly rose in his heart. The young man in brocade robe, the "young master" of the Luo Family disciples, was called Luo Peiran. He used to be the eldest son of the second branch and was about the same age as Luo Zheng.
After Luo Zheng was demoted to a slave, Luo Peiran replaced Luo Zheng and became the young master of the Luo Family.
Some time ago, it was said that Luo Peiran was in seclusion for cultivation and did not appear for a long time. Now that he came out of seclusion, it seemed that Luo Peiran's strength had improved again!
Luo Peiran's perception was very sharp. He was aware of Luo Zheng's unfriendly gaze. He turned his head to look at Luo Zheng. A playful smile appeared on his face. He walked in front of Luo Zheng and said, "Luo Zheng, I have been in seclusion for a long time. I didn't expect you to still be alive."
"Thank you for your kind words. I won't die," Luo Zheng replied in a muffled voice.
"Impudent! What kind of tone is this? How dare you speak to the young master like this? "
"You are just a slave. Why don't you kneel down? Quickly prostrate yourself on the ground and apologize to the young master. Otherwise, you will regret being born into this world. "
Several disciples of the Luo Family shouted. Looking at them, it was as if Luo Zheng had dug up their ancestral graves.
Luo Zheng looked around coldly. In the past, these disciples of the Luo Family were like dogs in front of him. They did not even dare to breathe loudly. Now that he had lost power, each and every one of them changed faces faster than flipping a book. They immediately became Luo Peiran's dogs.
Luo Peiran waved his hand and stopped those excited disciples of the Luo Family. He said to Luo Zheng with a smug expression, "Luo Zheng, do you know why I was in seclusion?"
Luo Zheng did not speak. He only looked at Luo Peiran with a gloomy expression.
"You should know that our Luo Family has two Worldly Creation Pills. Some time ago, I ate one of them. "Luo Peiran smacked his lips and said," This Worldly Creation Pill is indeed extraordinary. The pure medicinal power cleansed my body, allowing me to be reborn. I jumped from the Flesh Refinement Stage to the Bone Refinement Stage. Moreover, only a tenth of the medicinal power was used. It remained in my body and continuously nourished my body. I am only a fine line away from entering the Organ Refinement Stage. The Marrow Refinement Stage is just around the corner! "
The Worldly Creation Pill!
These two pills were the most precious treasures of the Luo Family. They were sacred medicines left behind by their ancestors. It was said that they were stored in the most hidden place of the family. Ordinary people were not allowed to use them.
According to the ancestral teachings, only disciples of the Luo Family who had reached the Bone Refinement Stage before the age of sixteen were qualified to use the Worldly Creation Pill.
The five realms of the Physical Body were divided into five major realms: the first was the Skin Refinement Stage, the second was the Flesh Refinement Stage, the third was the Bone Refinement Stage, the fourth was the Organ Refinement Stage, and the fifth was the Marrow Refinement Stage. The difference between each realm was huge. It was extremely difficult for an ordinary person to break through. Without dozens of years of tempering, it was impossible to break through.
An ordinary person who reached the third level of the Bone Refinement Stage before the age of thirty was considered to be extremely talented.
However, according to the ancestral teachings, only those who had reached the third level of the Bone Refinement Stage before the age of sixteen were qualified to use the Worldly Creation Pill!
To reach the Bone Refinement Stage before the age of sixteen was undoubtedly a genius among geniuses. Not to mention the Luo Family, even in the entire Chongming County, there had never been such a person. Therefore, for the past three hundred years, the Worldly Creation Pill had never been used.
Originally, Luo Zheng was the most promising person to take the Worldly Creation Pill.
At the age of fourteen, he had reached the peak of the second level of the Flesh Refinement Stage and was hailed as the hope of revitalizing the Luo Family by Royal Prince Chongyang. He was favored by the heavens and was a genius among geniuses!
Unfortunately, in this year, there was internal strife within the family. His father was harmed by his own brother because of his pure heart. Luo Zheng was demoted to a servant and became a human target. He was reduced to a prisoner and his cultivation stagnated. He missed the opportunity to take the Worldly Creation Pill.
Luo Peiran's talent was ordinary and he had just reached the second level of the Flesh Refinement Stage at the age of sixteen. He was not qualified to take the Worldly Creation Pill, but he still took it.
The Worldly Creation Pill belonged to him, but it was eaten by this kind of untalented trash. Even though Luo Zheng's temperament had been completely smoothed out over the past two years, he still could not help but become agitated. He angrily said, "Luo Peiran, you dare to disregard the Luo Family's ancestral teachings and take the sacred medicine for yourself. You're worse than an animal!"
"Hmph, in my eyes, you're worse than an insect in the cracks of a rock! I've already stepped into the peak of the Bone Refinement Stage. I can hold a thousand jin in one hand. You're just a mere servant. I can crush you with one hand. Today, I've come out of seclusion to celebrate, so I'll first find a human target to test my strength on! " Luo Peiran did not take Luo Zheng's words to heart. Speaking to here, he casually pointed and said, "I choose you!"
He did not choose Luo Zheng. Instead, he found a middle-aged man. When the middle-aged man saw Luo Peiran point at him, his entire body suddenly trembled. Although he wore thick leather armor on his chest that could withstand a lot of damage, facing the Bone Refinement Stage Luo Peiran, he could not help but shiver. His crotch was suddenly wet.
Then Luo Peiran took a deep breath. He clenched his hands into fists and assumed the posture of the Luo Family's "Red Sandalwood Fist". He wanted to show off, so he operated his heart technique to the extreme. His entire body was faintly shrouded in a faint purple light.
"Spare … spare my life … Young Master, please spare my life!" When the human target saw Luo Peiran's imposing manner, his eyes revealed an expression of despair. If this fist came crashing down, he would definitely die. He begged for mercy and was about to kneel down.
"Boom!"
How could Luo Peiran listen to the human target's pleas for mercy? This fist hit the center of the human target's chest. There was a dull sound. The leather armor on the human target's chest was forcibly broken into pieces. His entire chest was shattered. The human target directly hit the wall of the Drill Hall and bounced to the ground, motionless.
With just one punch, he had killed the fully armed human target.
"Young Master's fist is mighty. I'm afraid we can't find a second one among the young people of the Luo Family!"
"Young Master will definitely revitalize the Luo Family and bring the Luo Family to greater heights!"
The Luo Family's children seized the opportunity to madly flatter him.
Luo Peiran seemed to be very satisfied with the effect of this fist. Then he looked at Luo Zheng with evil intentions.
Luo Zheng subconsciously took a step back. Even though his foundation was quite a bit stronger than that middle-aged man's, he still couldn't take Luo Peiran's fist.
Luo Peiran chuckled. He reached out his hand and fiercely patted Luo Zheng's shoulder. "Don't worry, I won't beat you to death so quickly. I want you to see that I, Luo Peiran, am much stronger than trash like you!"
When Luo Peiran finished speaking and was about to leave, he suddenly thought of something. He turned around and said, "Right, I forgot something. I heard that my genius cousin didn't do well in the Blue Cloud Sect. She offended a great figure and was sent to Purgatory Mountain to reflect on her mistakes! When I enter the Viscera Refinement Realm, I'll go to the Blue Cloud Sect to save her, hahaha … "
When he heard this, Luo Zheng's heart immediately tightened!
＝＝＝＝＝

Chapter 2
Luo Zheng didn't care if he was demoted to a servant. He didn't care if he became a target for the disciples of the Luo Clan. Even if the Heaven and Earth Fortune Pill that should have been his was taken by Luo Peiran, he still didn't care.
However, his sister, Luo Yan, was his biggest weakness!
Luo Yan was the only hope of the Luo Clan. It was also because Luo Yan's talent was extremely high that she was accepted as an inner disciple of the Blue Cloud Sect at the age of thirteen. She left the Luo Clan and was able to survive the turmoil of the clan.
In these two years, Luo Zheng didn't know any news about his sister because of his status as a servant. Now that he heard from Luo Peiran, his sister's situation seemed to be very bad. He immediately fell into endless worry.
He even forgot to dodge when the disciples of the Luo Clan beat him up. He took a few solid punches before he finally reacted …
At night, Luo Zheng returned to the cellar with injuries all over his body.
"This is your medicine!" The steward of the Luo Clan casually threw down a paper bag and retreated outside.
After all, the human targets weren't made of steel. If they didn't have medicine to treat their injuries, they would die in a few days due to the accumulation of internal injuries. Therefore, the Luo Clan would distribute medicine to these human targets every day.
However, these medicines were all ordinary medicines and their healing effects weren't very good.
Luo Zheng opened the paper bag and saw that there was only one pill inside. His face darkened and he angrily said: "Steward Fang! Why is there only one pill today? "
"You should be thankful that there's enough for you to eat. What? You think it's too little? "Steward Fang said indifferently.
"The Luo Clan distributes three healing pills every day. Now there's only one. It's obvious that you embezzled it. In the Luo Clan, embezzlement is a serious crime. Steward Fang, aren't you afraid of death?" Luo Zheng shouted sternly, his eyes fixed on Steward Fang.
"Hey, of course I'm afraid. However, I'm not afraid of a little servant like you. What? You want to rebel? I just can't stand your attitude. You always think you're a master. Bah! Why don't you look in the mirror and see what you look like! Hahaha! "Steward Fang's every word was ear-piercing.
Hearing this, Luo Zheng calmed down. His clear eyes looked at Steward Fang indifferently, but there was a deep murderous intent hidden in his eyes, as if he was looking at a dead object.
Seeing Luo Zheng's expression, Steward Fang felt a little scared. He walked up and poked Luo Zheng's chest with his hand. "You're not convinced? Why are you looking at me like that? Do you want to eat me? "
Luo Zheng abruptly exerted strength in his chest. With a forceful shake, the force was transmitted to Steward Fang's body. Steward Fang immediately staggered and fell to the ground.
"You … You're just a mere servant. You want to rebel?" Steward Fang crawled up from the ground, his face full of panic.
Luo Zheng took two steps forward and cracked his knuckles. He said sternly, "Even a steward with a different surname dares to be so arrogant. Do you really think I don't dare to touch you?"
Seeing this, Steward Fang didn't want to stay here for a moment longer. He took to his heels and fled outside, closing the cellar's iron door with a bang.
"The actions of a lowly person!" Luo Zheng sneered and shook his head. He was too lazy to argue with this kind of person.
He quietly sat down and took out a match to light an oil lamp. He hastily flipped through a few pages of a book. He was worried about his sister, Luo Yan. How could he read with such an impatient heart?
I can't stay in the Luo Family any longer! But my strength is only in the Flesh Refining Realm. Let alone going to the Blue Cloud Sect, I can't even take half a step out of the Luo Family's cellar.
Luo Zheng walked quickly in the narrow cellar. His chest was heaving up and down like a trapped beast that couldn't find an exit.
Strength. My strength is still too weak. Otherwise, how could a small Luo Family trap me?
But in this world, cultivation is done step by step, one step at a time. Now that I'm a servant, I have to be a human target every day. I have no time to cultivate. If this continues, I'll be beaten to death sooner or later.
The more he thought about it, the more anxious he became. He cast his gaze on the table. The shabby 《Heavenly Dao Constitution》 quietly lay there.
"This kind of broken book has a lot of principles, but it's useless to me. What's the point of reading it?" Luo Zheng bitterly picked up the book and tore it from the middle. He put it on the oil lamp and burned it to the ground.
The bean-sized flame instantly ignited the book, emitting a raging flame.
Looking at the book gradually burning, Luo Zheng's heart gave birth to a trace of regret. He complained, "Luo Zheng, oh Luo Zheng, why must you vent your anger on a book? This book teaches people to be good. What's wrong with being sensible and knowing shame? What's wrong is that you're weak and can only be manipulated by others, like a lamb waiting to be slaughtered! "
Unfortunately, the fire was fierce and the book had already turned into a pile of ashes.
Just as he was feeling vexed, Luo Zheng suddenly saw a ray of golden light among the ashes.
"Huh? What's this? "
Luo Zheng brushed the ashes aside and picked up the ray of golden light. He found a thin piece of gold leaf.
When he flipped through the book before, he didn't find this piece of gold leaf. Presumably, this piece of gold leaf was hidden in the middle of the book.
What's the use of a mere piece of gold leaf?
In this world, there was no lack of gold. Especially for a big family like the Luo family, gold was as cheap as dirt!
However, when Luo Zheng's gaze focused on the gold leaf, something strange happened!
On the gold leaf, there were densely engraved characters. These characters were shaped like tadpoles. Luo Zheng didn't recognize a single one of them.
Under his gaze, this piece of gold leaf quickly disintegrated into thousands of small pieces of gold leaf. Each small piece of gold leaf was engraved with a tadpole character. These small pieces of gold leaf stuck to Luo Zheng.
On his face, in his eyes, neck, arms, body, legs … …
Every part of Luo Zheng's body was covered with these small pieces of gold leaf.
The last small piece of gold leaf shot directly into Luo Zheng's brain. Luo Zheng's whole body trembled violently as if he was hit by a big hammer. At the same time, the small pieces of gold leaf on his body shone brightly.
When the golden light gradually faded, these thousands of small pieces of gold leaf also quietly disappeared into Luo Zheng's body. Some memories appeared in his mind out of nowhere, some memories that didn't belong to him.
"The Supreme Refining Method … …"
"The Number One Refining Method of All Time … …"
"Using the body as the tool, using my own body as the spirit, refining and cleansing my body, I can become the Hongmeng … …"
This was a refining method?
Although Luo Zheng didn't know how to refine, he knew that refining was a highly sought after profession. Even with the Luo family's strong financial resources, they still couldn't recruit the lowest level refining master. It was obvious that refining masters were in high demand.
But using the body as the tool, what did this mean?
Could it be … … this refining method was to refine one's own body into a magic weapon?
This unbelievable conjecture quickly became a reality.
He suddenly found that his body began to heat up unceasingly, just like a fever. His temperature rose sharply.
So hot! If this went on, his whole body would be roasted.
In a hurry, he rushed to the end of the cellar where there was a water tank. This water tank was for Luo Zheng to get water from.
Without even thinking, he jumped into the water tank.
"Sizzle … …"
Steam billowed out from the water tank. After a while, the water in the tank was evaporated by his body temperature. The whole cellar was filled with mist.
So much water, but Luo Zheng's body temperature didn't drop. Instead, it got higher and higher. His skin emitted a dark red light, just like a piece of red-hot iron.
In the end, he spun around twice in the same place, and then fell into the cellar full of mist.
In Luo Zheng's mind, an inconceivable change was taking place.
In his mind, a huge furnace suddenly appeared. The furnace was dark green, and there were nine dragon carvings on the walls of the furnace.
Each of the dragon reliefs had a different color. There were cyan, black, white, purple … … these dragon reliefs were baring their fangs and brandishing their claws, looking very lifelike.
Eight of the dragons had their eyes closed. Only the eyes of the bottommost Qinglong were open, staring at Luo Zheng.
That Qinglong's eyes seemed to have settled down for tens of millions of years. Looking at Luo Zheng indifferently, he felt a great power.
Ge ge ge ge ge ge … …
Under the gaze of the dragon eyes, Luo Zheng's soul was constantly trembling. Soon, cracks appeared on his soul body, showing signs of collapse.
Just as Luo Zheng's soul was about to collapse, a dragon roar came from Qinglong's mouth. Then, the huge furnace started to rotate, and a strange flame ignited in the furnace.
It was a black flame!
In this world, there was actually a flame of this color, which seemed to be able to burn everything in the world!
Before Luo Zheng could exclaim in surprise, the huge furnace came down on his head, and the raging black flame immediately wrapped around his soul.
The pain of the soul being burned was not something an ordinary person could endure. However, Luo Zheng was in a soul state, so he couldn't even faint. He could only grit his teeth and bear the pain.
"Ah ah ah ah, let me die!"
At this moment, Luo Zheng only wanted to die to relieve this pain.
But for him, even death was an extravagant hope. He was in a soul state, so he couldn't bite his tongue to commit suicide.
Every time his soul couldn't hold on, it would shatter and be annihilated.
Suddenly, the furnace would emit a seven-colored light, which immediately repaired Luo Zheng's soul.
In this way, it was burned, shattered, repaired, burned again, shattered again, repaired again … …
Over and over again, endlessly.
This pain of hovering between life and death lasted for an unknown amount of time, but in the end, it stopped.
"Finally, it's over." Luo Zheng let out a long sigh. Thinking of the pain just now, he still had a lingering fear. At the same time, he found that his soul was emitting a faint golden light.
After a long time, he separated from his mind and slowly woke up.
In his mind, the huge furnace had stopped rotating, but the black flame in the furnace didn't go out. It was just that the fire was restrained, so it didn't look so terrible.
Luo Zheng already understood that his soul and body had been tempered by the furnace just now.
The world was big, and there were all kinds of strange things. Some refining masters used all kinds of strange methods to refine weapons. Some refining masters didn't hesitate to kill people and collect human blood to refine magic weapons. There were even some who sealed a person's soul into a weapon, turning it into an evil weapon.
However, this refining method was actually to refine one's own body into a magic weapon. This method was unheard of. It was really too crazy … …
Fortune and misfortune lay in wait. After calming down, Luo Zheng also thought it through. This kind of thing happened to him, so it wasn't necessarily a bad thing!
The magic weapons in this world were divided into five stages: Profound Weapon, Spiritual Weapon, Immortal Weapon, Sacred Weapon, Divine Weapon, and Grandmist Spiritual Treasure. Each stage was also divided into high, middle, and low grades.
Luo Zheng's body had just been refined into a magic weapon, which was only the lowest grade of Profound Weapon.
Using the grade of a magic weapon to describe himself was indeed a very strange thing. Luo Zheng's face showed a trace of a bitter smile.
Looking out from the cellar's only vent, the sky was already bright. Unknowingly, he had been tormented for an entire night.
It was strange that after a sleepless night, he didn't feel the slightest bit tired. Instead, he was in high spirits, and his spirit was very good.
Moreover, at this moment, his mood had also calmed down, and he didn't feel as anxious as last night. The principle in the book was right. Every sip and every bite was predetermined. Only by stabilizing the state of mind could one face things calmly.

Chapter 3
Steward Fang was punished yesterday, but he didn't see him today. After a few servants put on leather armor and shackles for Luo Zheng, he was taken to the Martial Arts Hall.
As usual, a group of Luo Family disciples were training hard in the Martial Arts Hall in the morning mist.
With their bare arms, they punched the rows of stone men in the corner with all their might. Every time their fists landed on a stone man, there would be a slight explosion, and even the air would vibrate along with it.
The human targets standing on the other side were all grief-stricken, their faces drooping, and their mouths full of bitterness.
This kind of life of being punched and kicked day and night was really hard to endure. Sometimes, with a body full of injuries, they would lie in bed, tossing and turning in pain, unable to sleep. Unfortunately, they had no freedom at all. They had no choice but to be beaten.
"Human targets, stand properly!" The Luo Family instructor shouted loudly.
All the human targets stood in a row, their backs straight. The human targets knew the instructor's temper very well. If they were the slightest bit careless, they would be whipped. The Luo Family instructor's whip was not an ordinary whip. The slightest touch would cause their skin to split open.
The Luo Family disciples each chose their own human targets. The one who chose Luo Zheng was a branch family disciple with a body as sturdy as a bear. This branch family disciple was called Luo Dalong.
When the other human targets saw that Luo Zheng was chosen by Luo Dalong, they all showed a pitiful expression.
This Luo Dalong's talent was average. His strength was only in the Skin Refining Realm, but he was born with divine strength. His strength was comparable to someone in the Flesh Refining Realm. Moreover, he was ferocious, even a bit brutal. Many human targets were either killed or injured by him. Being chosen by him as a human target was undoubtedly very miserable.
Luo Dalong raised his fist and warmed up a bit. He looked at Luo Zheng with a hint of excitement. Recently, there were fewer prisoners on death row. Many of them were bought by other families. The Luo Family's human targets had been difficult to replenish, so the Luo Family's human targets could be considered a scarce resource.
Beating the human targets could not only exercise the body, but also vent the unhappiness in his heart. This was the reason why Luo Dalong was so excited. What was even more valuable was that this human target was once the Luo Family's young master.
The once high and mighty Young Patriarch was now begging for mercy under his fist. Just thinking about it made him feel good.
Facing Luo Dalong, Luo Zheng frowned. This Luo Dalong's strength was especially great. Last time, he had suffered a loss under this person's fist. He was beaten by this person and suffered internal injuries. He had to rest for half a month to recover.
However, after two years of being a human target, he had learned to be as calm as still water. He quickly calmed down and even carefully adjusted the leather armor on his chest. Only then did he straighten his posture and face Luo Dalong.
Then, Luo Dalong rushed towards him. Luo Dalong practiced an extremely fierce and overbearing fist technique called "Raging Bull Rushing Fist". This fist technique was fierce and overbearing, full of power.
Luo Dalong was like an enraged bull. Bringing along a burst of chaotic wind, he threw a Bull Rushing Punch straight at Luo Zheng's chest.
Luo Zheng took a deep breath and puffed out his chest. This way, he could rely on his leather armor to offset the power of the punch to the greatest extent.
"Puff!"
Although the thick leather armor on his chest reduced the power of the punch, the powerful force of the punch still seeped through the leather armor and hit his chest like a muffled hammer. At this moment, he quickly exhaled the air in his chest, making his chest deflate in an instant.
"Deflecting Force!"
Exhaling the air quickly made his chest shrink to form a buffer zone, which could offset the opponent's power again. This little trick was also the secret of Luo Zheng's survival as a human target for two years!
However, Luo Dalong's punch was too fierce. After the power was reduced twice, it was still overbearing. Luo Zheng's face showed a trace of a bitter smile. His whole body was like a kite with a broken string, and he fell back heavily.
Lying on the ground, Luo Zheng was still a little dizzy. He thought that he was finished this time. This punch would probably cause him serious internal injuries. But at this moment, he strangely found that he didn't feel the slightest bit of pain.
Not only did he not feel pain, but a strange warm current emerged from his chest. As soon as the warm current appeared, Luo Zheng's body immediately reacted. He felt that his body was like a hungry wolf, quickly swallowing up the warm current.
Then the warm current spread to his internal organs, his four limbs, his hair, and his skin, making his whole body feel warm. Not only did he not feel pain, but he also felt extremely comfortable.
"What's going on?" Luo Zheng's face was full of astonishment. "This warm current is actually cleansing my body!"
Although Luo Zheng had been reduced to a servant, he was, after all, the young master of the Luo family. He still had this kind of knowledge.
Medicines that could cleanse the body were very rare. For example, the Luo family's Heaven and Earth Fortune Elixir had the effect of cleansing the body. But how rare was the Heaven and Earth Fortune Elixir? The Luo family had only accumulated two Heaven and Earth Fortune Elixirs in several hundred years. From this point, one could see how precious it was.
This warm current that could cleanse the body appeared without reason. Luo Zheng lay on the ground and thought for a while. Soon, he connected the dots that appeared yesterday.
"Using my body as a tool, using my own body as a spirit, tempering my body thousands of times, cleansing my body …"
Could it be that this so-called thousands of times of tempering was to be beaten?
Just like what was recorded in the gold foil, his own body was like a magical weapon. Didn't refining weapons require thousands of times of tempering in order to forge a high-grade magical weapon?
As long as he was beaten, he could produce a warm current that could cleanse the body! As long as he was beaten, it was equal to continuously swallowing Heaven and Earth Fortune Elixirs!
Thinking of this possibility, Luo Zheng's mind became heated. His heart even trembled with excitement.
In order to verify his guess, Luo Zheng got up.
Although he wasn't injured and Luo Dalong's punch had greatly benefited him, he still pretended to be in pain and stood up with great difficulty. In order to pretend to be more realistic, he even trembled non-stop.
When Luo Dalong saw Luo Zheng get up, his trembling face revealed an astonished expression. He originally thought that after taking this punch, Luo Zheng would be crippled if not dead. However, Luo Zheng was actually able to get up. This made Luo Dalong feel somewhat embarrassed.
"Heh, as expected of someone at the peak of the Flesh Refinement Realm. You're so resilient! Lie down for me! "After saying this, Luo Dalong threw another punch straight at Luo Zheng.
"Boom!"
Luo Zheng was sent flying again. He was like a human-shaped sandbag, rolling several times on the ground. When he landed, he secretly felt refreshed. That warm current appeared again the moment he was beaten. It turned into small snakes that drilled into his internal organs and meridians, constantly refining his body and cleansing his organs.
It was too comfortable. Luo Zheng felt as if he was bathing in the spring breeze. His whole body was extremely comfortable. His eyes were brimming with vigor. The more he was hit, the brighter and more energetic his eyes became.
"Go to hell!"
"Bang!"
"I'll kill you!"
"Boom!"
Every time a warm current appeared, it purified Luo Zheng's body. To Luo Zheng, Luo Dalong was a hardworking blacksmith, constantly tempering Luo Zheng's "magical weapon" with his own fists.
This kind of beating continued for quite a while before Luo Dalong stopped. Panting, he looked at Luo Zheng on the ground. He was extremely surprised. Before this, he had heard that Luo Zheng could take a beating very well. He didn't expect this guy to be so tenacious. After taking so many punches from him, he could still get up. Although he was trembling every time he got up, it looked like he was struggling very much …
How could Luo Dalong know that Luo Zheng's weak and feeble appearance was completely faked? In fact, he was full of vitality and was enjoying the refreshing feeling of the warm current washing his body.
When those human targets saw this scene, they secretly cursed Luo Zheng for being an idiot. Since he couldn't get up, he shouldn't force himself. In any case, he could have been sent back to rest for a day. Now that he got up, he was still beaten. Wasn't this shameless? Could it be that this guy was addicted to being a human target and liked to be beaten by others?
Luo Zheng didn't get up for the last time. In fact, he was somewhat unsatisfied. He was addicted to the feeling of the warm current washing his body!
However, he was beaten down again and again and got up again and again. It was really too valiant.
If he got up again, he was afraid that this show couldn't go on. It was inevitable that someone would see a flaw and suspect him. Therefore, he decided … to get beaten again tomorrow.
Seeing that Luo Zheng couldn't get up again, Luo Dalong was relieved. If he couldn't even beat him down, he would have lost a lot of face.
At night, Luo Zheng limped back to the cellar. When the Luo family's servants locked the cellar door, he was immediately full of energy.
Today, Steward Fang still didn't show up. Instead, the servants sent over three pills. This time, he didn't embezzle the pills. It was enough.
Yesterday, he punished Steward Fang a little and he became obedient? Luo Zheng shook his head. He didn't believe it.
He was very clear about the thoughts of a villain like Steward Fang. He definitely wouldn't let it go. He reckoned that Steward Fang was hatching some evil plan to harm him.
Who cares! He had to be wary of this kind of villain. However, he also couldn't take him too seriously. He would deal with whatever came his way.
He threw the three pills to the side. With his current body condition, he didn't need these cheap pills.
After being beaten up for the whole day, his body was very dirty. Then, he took off his clothes and scooped out a large ladle of cold water from the water tank. He poured it from head to toe.
Hualalala …
The clear and transparent cold water poured down from his head. When it flowed to the ground, it became black muddy water. The black muddy water was mixed with some light white impurities.
When he was being beaten, he discovered that because of the warm current washing, the impurities in his body were constantly being forced out.
What was the Flesh Refining Realm?
It was to refine out the impurities in the body.
What was the Bone Refining Realm?
It was to refine out the impurities in the bones.
What was the Viscera Refining Realm?
It was …
The Five Stages of the Flesh Refining Realm was a process of refining the body. First, the skin was refined, then the flesh was refined, then the bones were refined, and then the organs were refined. From the outside to the inside, it was done step by step. When the impurities in the spinal cord were all cleaned out, one could break through the Flesh Refining Realm and raise one's life to a higher level.
The biggest difference between Luo Zheng and other people was that he needed to rely on his own training to be able to remove the impurities in his body. This process was very slow and needed to accumulate over a long period of time. If it was short, it would take a few years. If it was long, it would take a few decades or even a lifetime.
However, Luo Zheng now needed to passively take a beating. Using the warm current that was comparable to the Heaven and Earth Fortune Pill to wash himself, he could expel the impurities in his body!
Compared to other people who painstakingly cultivated and could only expel a little bit of impurities in a year, his speed was a hundred times or even a thousand times faster!
Luo Zheng was already at the peak of the Flesh Refining Realm. However, because he had been a human target for the past two years and had no time to cultivate, his realm had remained at the peak of the Flesh Refining Realm.
However, after today's beating, the impurities in his body had been washed out. He felt that his body seemed to have undergone a qualitative change. His body was already incomparably pure. When he was bathing just now, he had already discovered that among the black impurities, there was also a portion of light white impurities.
The impurities that were expelled from his body were pure black filth. As for the light white impurities, they were the impurities that he had forced out from his bones. This was the proof that he had entered the Bone Refining Realm!
He moved his iron bed aside and opened up a space in the cellar. He operated the Red Sandalwood Fist. His entire body was bathed in a layer of purple light. This layer of purple light was actually comparable to the purple light that covered Luo Peiran's body.
He punched the air, and the air immediately produced an explosive sound.
"Bo!"
The powerful sound wave produced a scattered airflow. The candles, papers, and other small objects in the cellar were stirred into a mess.
Unfortunately, the cellar was narrow and there was no stone lock. The stone man could allow him to test his strength, but he was also afraid of making too much noise and letting others know.

Chapter 4
That night, Luo Zheng was so excited that he couldn't sleep. He only slept for two hours, but he was still full of energy.
Early the next morning, the Luo family's servants opened the cellar's lock, put on the leather armor and shackles on Luo Zheng, and took him out.
After entering the Bone Refining stage, his body had undergone a qualitative change. This change was hard to describe. Even small things like walking had changed. Every step he took was easier, more coordinated, and more effortless.
If it weren't for these damned shackles restraining him, he would have wanted to run forward.
Under the guidance of the servants, Luo Zheng found that there was something wrong with this road.
The entire Luo family occupied a large area, but the family's planning was in order. Except for the Martial Arts Hall, the Discussion Pavilion, the Herb Garden, and the Weapon Refining Workshop, which were shared by the family, were basically planned in the front yard of the residence.
But now, this road took a detour, and seemed to be going to the backyard of the Luo family!
Luo Zheng's brows slightly wrinkled. He didn't say anything, and just waited and watched.
He hadn't been to the backyard of the Luo family for a long time. The appearance of this place had changed a lot, especially the residence of the second and third branches of the Luo family. There were many pavilions, terraces, and pavilions. They also opened up several ponds, built small bridges over flowing water, and built water pavilions.
The workmanship of these buildings was so exquisite that it made people gasp in amazement. The carved beams and painted rafters, the patterns of dragons and phoenixes, were all painted with gold, and the roofs were installed with shining gems …
Seeing the actions of the second and third branches, Luo Zheng couldn't help but sigh. Although the Luo family had a rich heritage, and this amount of money was nothing, in today's world, only the strong could survive. For a martial artist, glory, splendor, wealth, and rank were only trivial. If a family was content to enjoy life …
This Luo family would most likely be defeated by the hands of his second and third uncles.
After passing by a pond, Luo Zheng turned into another courtyard.
In this courtyard, there were two people sitting opposite each other, drinking tea. They were very happy.
Luo Zheng took a closer look. One of them was Steward Fang, who had disappeared for two days. The other person was an old man over fifty years old, dressed in silk and satin. Luo Zheng also knew this old man. His name was Huang Ge, and he was originally a servant of the Luo Residence.
Because Huang Ge's wife was the wet nurse of his third uncle's eldest son, Luo Chengyun, coupled with the fact that Huang Ge was very good at flattering and studying relationships, he had a very good relationship with the third branch of the Luo family, and his status was rising steadily.
Now that Second Uncle and Third Uncle had taken control of the Luo Clan, Huang Ge's status had risen even more. He had become the head steward of the Luo Clan, and even the branch descendants of the Luo Clan were nothing in his eyes.
Luo Zheng had long heard about his arrogance.
Luo Zheng hadn't even walked in when he heard Steward Fang say to Huang Ge, "Lord Huang, the courtyard that young master Chengyun bestowed upon you is truly a work of fine quality. If I'm not mistaken, the jade dragon carved on the door plaque is made from the finest corundum seed material, correct?"
Huang Ge laughed mischievously and said: "You really know your stuff. It's not just the jade dragon. Look at the glazed roof tiles and that copper lion. They were all made by the best craftsmen in Chongyang County … …"
After Steward Fang appraised them one by one, he clicked his tongue and said: "Elder Huang, everything about your small courtyard is good, but it's lacking something!"
"My courtyard has everything it wants. What could it possibly lack?" Huang Ge said proudly.
Steward Fang giggled, "Of course, you're lacking a nimble servant who can take care of your daily needs. See, I've brought this person here for you. With this person as your servant, I guarantee that you'll have a lot of face!"
"Who is this person?" Huang Ge asked curiously.
Steward Fang pointed to the entrance of the courtyard and said: "Elder Huang, look!"
Huang Ge followed Steward Fang's finger and saw Luo Zheng at a glance. How could he not recognize the former famous young master of the Luo family?
Luo Zheng stood at the entrance of the courtyard. He had heard Steward Fang and Huang Ge's words without the slightest error. A burst of anger rose in his heart. These two dog slaves had such big words and were too impudent.
Although he, Luo Zheng, had been demoted to a servant, this was his Luo family's matter.
Even ordinary branch family descendants didn't dare to be too unreasonable in front of him. After all, Luo Zheng's status in the past was still there, and he was the eldest son of the eldest branch.
That Steward Fang actually dared to instigate Huang Ge and order him around like a servant who served tea and poured water!
Huang Ge sized up Luo Zheng with his eyes, and a sinister smile floated on his wrinkled old face. "Asking this kid to take care of my food and daily life is quite appropriate. I just don't know if Young Master Chengyun will have any opinions?"
"Don't worry, Elder Huang. You are the head steward of our Luo family. With just a casual word, you can transfer Luo Zheng from the Martial Arts Hall here. This Luo Zheng is now nothing more than a servant without any status. Every day, he has to be sent to the Martial Arts Hall to be beaten until he wails like ghosts and howls like wolves. How comfortable would it be to be a servant here? At most, he would just have to pour a basin of feces and urine … "Steward Fang continued.
Steward Fang's words moved Huang Ge. For someone like Huang Ge who had climbed up from the bottom, what he valued the most was face. The former young master of the Luo family had to personally pour a chamber pot for him. This was indeed an interesting matter. Huang Ge nodded and asked Steward Fang: "How about we do it this way?"
"Let's do it this way!" After Steward Fang nodded, he stood up and called several servants to bring Luo Zheng in.
However, Luo Zheng stood in the same place, motionless. No matter how the servants dragged him, he didn't move an inch.
Although these servants had some strength, how could they move Luo Zheng who was in the Bone Refining stage?
Luo Zheng's feet were like wedges that had been hit by heavy hammers, deeply nailed to the ground. The servants exerted all their strength, sweating profusely and gasping for breath.
"Luo Zheng, I'm giving you a chance to serve Master Huang. Don't refuse a toast only to be forced to drink a forfeit!" Steward Fang said with a flick of his sleeve.
At this moment, Luo Zheng's eyes flashed with an ominous glint, and he roared. After entering the Bone Refining stage, the contraction of the ribs in his chest was even stronger. This roar was like a thunderclap, shaking the ears of the servants and Huang Ge. It was very uncomfortable.
"Huang Ge, Fang Cong! Even if my second uncle, Luo Bingquan, was here, he wouldn't dare to ask me to serve him. You two lowly servants with different surnames are actually so arrogant. I don't know who gave you the courage to talk nonsense as if there was no one around. You want me to serve you? "
Luo Zheng's aura surged towards Steward Fang, instantly scaring Steward Fang until he retreated a few steps back and hid behind Huang Ge.
Steward Fang deliberately brought Luo Zheng here today to let Huang Ge deal with Luo Zheng. Now that he saw Luo Zheng's agitated appearance, he knew that this matter was already half done. Steward Huang Ge climbed up step by step from a servant, and he hated it when people called him lowly. This time, Luo Zheng was afraid that he wouldn't be able to bear the consequences.
Hearing Luo Zheng's words, Huang Ge didn't move. He narrowed his eyes and said gloomily, "Luo Zheng, don't forget your current status. You're the lowest servant, not the former young master. The current young master is called Luo Peiran, not Luo Zheng. It's your honor to be called a human target to serve me."
"Scram!"
Luo Zheng shook hard, and the servants were suddenly bounced off him, falling to the ground.
Seeing this scene, Huang Ge continued, "Luo Zheng, you're a sinner, don't tell me you want to rebel? According to the clan's rules, you'll be put to death by a thousand cuts! "
Luo Zheng sneered and strode into the courtyard. As he walked, he laughed and said, "Clan rules? A person with a different surname dares to talk about clan rules in front of me? Today, I'll let you understand what clan rules are! "
After saying this, Luo Zheng raised his hand and was about to hit Huang Ge. Suddenly, a burst of popping sounds came from his bones. That was the sound of bones cracking when he used his strength to the extreme.
"Luo Zheng, don't you dare! If you hit me, young master Chengyun definitely won't let you off. You're just a human target with no power or influence in the Luo family. Aren't you afraid of being beaten to death … "Huang Ge said calmly.
"Slap!"
As soon as Huang Ge's voice fell, Luo Zheng's slap had already swept across his face. After entering the Bone Refining stage, Luo Zheng's strength had almost doubled. Although this slap wasn't at full strength, it still wasn't light.
Huang Ge's old face was deathly pale at first. Then, five fingerprints floated up, as clear as if they were imprinted on his face. Half of his face was swollen like a pig's head.
"Luo family's rules. Talking nonsense and criticizing others. Slap your mouth!"
"Slap!"
"Luo family's rules. Helping a villain do evil. Opinionated. Slap your mouth!"
"Slap your mouth!"
"Luo family's rules. Stirring up trouble. Inverting black and white. Slap your mouth!"
"Slap your mouth!"
"Luo family's rules …"
"Slap!"
With each slap, a cloud of blood burst out. Steward Fang saw this scene and his whole body trembled.
This … this …
This was a little different from the script he had imagined. This Luo Zheng was usually treated as a human target. He didn't seem to have any temper and had a resigned look. How come he even dared to hit Old Huang now?
Steward Fang didn't understand that Luo Zheng had resigned himself to adversity because he didn't want to bicker with servants like them.
At this time, many of the Luo family's disciples had already gathered at the door. When they saw this scene, their faces were full of surprise. At the same time, they felt relieved.
This chief steward, Huang Ge, relied on his relationship with Luo Chengyun to run amok in the Luo family. It seemed that he really regarded himself as the master of the Luo family. Usually, some of the branch family's disciples had been bullied by Huang Ge. Everyone tolerated him for the sake of the second branch family's face. But this Huang Ge didn't know how to restrain himself. Because they tolerated him, it increased Huang Ge's arrogance.
Today, someone jumped out and taught this guy a lesson. It was indeed satisfying.
But …
These Luo family's disciples knew very well that an outsider had the right to be arrogant because he had a strong backing. Huang Ge's arrogance was because of his relationship with Luo Chengyun.
In addition, although Huang Ge was arrogant, in front of the second and third branches, he showed his true colors as a servant to the extreme. The second and third branches liked him very much.
Luo Zheng's current identity was that of a servant. Now that he had hit Huang Ge, he would be in big trouble.
This Luo Zheng was definitely going to be in big trouble …
Luo Zheng slapped Huang Ge dozens of times before he stopped. Huang Ge's face was badly mutilated and dripping with blood. If one didn't look carefully, one wouldn't be able to distinguish his nose and mouth. His white hair was also scattered, making him look like a ghost.
After Luo Zheng stopped, Huang Ge's smashed mouth moved. He vaguely said: "You, you wait …"
Before Huang Ge could finish, Luo Zheng slapped him again. Huang Ge's eyes rolled back and he fell to the ground with his head raised.
After teaching Huang Ge a lesson, Luo Zheng's gaze turned towards Steward Fang again.
When Steward Fang saw Luo Zheng's gaze, he couldn't help but tremble. He took two steps back and shouted: "Luo Zheng, you're a servant!"
"What's wrong with being a servant?" Luo Zheng approached step by step.
"How dare you offend your superior!" Steward Fang said.
"What's superior? What's inferior? My surname is Luo. Even if I'm a servant, my surname is still Luo. Moreover, you forgot that my fist is bigger than yours, so I'm superior! My strength is stronger than yours, so I'm superior! My kung fu is better than yours, so I'm superior! "
As he spoke, Luo Zheng grabbed Steward Fang. With his strength at the Bone Refining stage, these servants were like obedient chickens in his hands. He grabbed Steward Fang and slapped him more than a dozen times.
When other people heard the slapping sounds, they felt a burst of toothache. How painful was that!
Finally, when Luo Zheng had enough, he threw Steward Fang onto Huang Ge's body. Both of them screamed. Luo Zheng said: "Today I'll teach you a lesson. You have to remember this pain. In the future, you'll be able to distinguish right from wrong. You'll understand what you can do and what you can't do!"
After speaking, Luo Zheng turned around and walked out of the small courtyard. As soon as he walked to the door, the Luo Clan's disciples and the group of servants who were watching suddenly dispersed.
＝＝＝＝＝

Chapter 5
Although no one dared to escort Luo Zheng, Luo Zheng still consciously came to the Drill Hall.
Although Luo Zheng was very dissatisfied with the Luo Family's current rules, Second Uncle and Third Uncle themselves couldn't follow the Ming Dynasty's rules, and their sons were also too idle. For example, Luo Peiran and Luo Chengyun, when did they put the family rules in their eyes? This was also the reason why a few servants who couldn't be seen in public dared to make such a ruckus.
But others trampled on the family rules, others despised the family rules, but that didn't mean Luo Zheng didn't abide by them. He wasn't pedantic, but a kind of insistence.
The atmosphere in the Drill Hall was a bit different from the past.
The news that Luo Zheng beat up Steward Huang Ge and Steward Fang Cong had already spread throughout the Luo Family.
Two years ago, Luo Zheng was demoted to a family slave and became a human target in the Drill Hall. He had always resigned himself to it. No matter how the Luo Family's disciples beat him, he endured, let them go, and didn't say a word, like a docile sheep.
Everyone had already forgotten that he was once the Luo Family's young master, and they had also forgotten that Luo Zheng himself also had the strength of the Flesh Refining Stage.
Now these Luo Family's disciples understood that Luo Zheng wasn't a tolerant person. The Luo Family's disciples could beat him wantonly because he was surnamed Luo.
Others didn't have the qualifications!
Because of this, the Luo Family's disciples in the Drill Hall today looked at Luo Zheng with a faint sense of awe. When the Luo Family's instructor instructed the Luo Family's disciples to choose a human target, unexpectedly, no one chose Luo Zheng.
Luo Zheng showed a helpless and bitter smile. This wasn't the result he wanted …
What he needed most now was to temper his body, but these Luo Family's disciples directly ignored him. How could this be?
He couldn't go up and say, "I'm asking for a beating, so come and beat me up, right?"
Seeing the human targets around him being taken away one by one, leaving him all alone in the Drill Hall, Luo Zheng was very unhappy. The Luo Family's disciples shouldn't be so cowardly!
He walked over to Luo Dalong who was smashing the stone man and said, "Dalong, what's so good about hitting a stone man? I'll practice with you."
"This …" Even the impetuous Luo Dalong hesitated.
"I'm a human target, so of course I have to practice with you! Don't worry, my leather armor is thick and won't break. "Luo Zheng patted his chest and said.
Since Luo Zheng had said so, Luo Dalong was too embarrassed to refuse. Otherwise, he would appear to be too cowardly, even though his true intention was not to provoke Luo Zheng.
Luo Dalong had some misgivings in his heart. When he punched out, it was not the case. Normally, he could exert ten percent of his strength, but now, he could only exert five or six percent of his strength.
Luo Zheng was very dissatisfied with the fact that his soft fists didn't have a good tempering effect. The warm current generated from his fists was too little.
"Use more strength! Hit here hard! "
"Your fist speed is too slow. What are you worried about?"
"This fist seems to be the case, but it's still far from yesterday's."
Seeing a human target instructing his opponent to beat him up, the group of Luo Family disciples in the Martial Arts Hall were so surprised that their jaws dropped. They really couldn't guess what Luo Zheng was thinking.
Luo Dalong didn't think too much about it. Under Luo Zheng's guidance, his state slowly adjusted. His hands and feet gradually relaxed, and his strength returned to normal.
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
"Bang!"
The power of his fists frantically pounded Luo Zheng's body. Strands of warm current flowed into Luo Zheng's body, peeling off the impurities in his bones and refining them.
Every fist purified his bones a bit, and the strength and toughness of his bones also increased by a level.
As long as he was beaten, it was like swallowing a Heaven and Earth Fortune Pill. The joy brought about by this kind of qualitative change was indescribable. On the surface, he showed a painful expression, but in his heart, he wanted to shout: Let the fists come more fiercely!
The copper kettle used to measure time in the Martial Arts Hall leaked no less than three kettles of water. Six hours had passed.
At this time, the servants of the Luo Family brought in food. Whether it was the Luo Family disciples or the human target, they all needed to replenish their strength. However, the Luo Family disciples ate delicacies, while the human target was treated with water and hard steamed buns …
After six hours of tempering, Luo Zheng also felt very hungry. Tempering his body consumed a lot of his strength, but he didn't mind that the food tasted bad. He grabbed a steamed bun and was about to stuff it into his mouth.
At this time, a porcelain bowl suddenly appeared in front of Luo Zheng. It was filled with delicate fragrant meat, exuding an enticing aroma.
Luo Zheng looked up and saw that Luo Dalong had handed over his bowl. Luo Dalong smiled and said, "Let's eat together."
Luo Zheng didn't stand on ceremony. He ate big mouthfuls of steamed bun and meat.
"You hit Huang Ge. Second Young Master will deal with you," Luo Dalong said in a low voice.
Luo Zheng wolfed down the food. Ever since he became a human target, he hadn't eaten such delicious food for a long time. He nodded. He knew that Luo Dalong was reminding him out of kindness.
After all, he used to be the young master of the Luo Family. He knew more about the family's affairs than Luo Dalong and the other branch family disciples.
Second Uncle and Third Uncle didn't let him live for so long. The biggest reason was not that they were benevolent, but that he was too weak. He was like a dispensable ant, unable to pose any threat to them.
However, if Luo Zheng, this ant, bit them and made them feel a trace of pain, they wouldn't hesitate to kill him.
"But it's very satisfying. We've long disliked that old man surnamed Huang," Luo Dalong said with a smile.
Luo Dalong wasn't the only one who felt satisfied. Apart from the second and third branches, all of the Luo Family disciples felt satisfied.
Although the Luo Family disciples in the Martial Arts Practice Field didn't say it out loud like Luo Dalong, their eyes said it all.
In the past two years, the actions of the second branch and the third branch could be described as perverse. They greatly reduced the monthly allowances of the collateral family members. Even the medicinal pills used for cultivation were cut again and again. Even a few servants could climb over the head of the surnamed Luo. Based on what?
Almost all of the resources were given to Luo Peiran and Luo Chengyun. It would be strange if the branch family disciples were mentally balanced.
Now, everyone missed the time when Luo Zheng's father was the head of the family. At that time, the family rules were strict, but the Luo Family didn't have so much intrigue, and no servants dared to bully others. It wasn't so unfair!
It was a pity that those good days were gone and would never come back.
Even this kind of nostalgia, the Luo Family disciples only dared to hide it in their hearts. They didn't dare to criticize it, for fear that they would be punished by the "family rules".
This Luo Family was already rotten! Luo Zheng sighed in his heart. If there was a chance, when his strength grew, he would definitely gouge out this rotten sore of the Luo Family!
… …
… …
In front of the magnificent mansion of the Luo Family's third branch.
Huang Ge's head was wrapped in layers of gauze. Only his nose, eyes, and mouth were exposed. It was completely impossible to see his human appearance.
He knelt on the ground with a plop and cried in a high-pitched voice: "Young Master Chengyun, you have to make a decision for me!"
In front of Huang Ge, a young man in black leaned on a chair. This young man had a handsome appearance, but there was an arrogant and ruthless aura between his eyebrows. He was the second young master of the Luo Family, Luo Chengyun.
"I heard that you want to take Luo Zheng as a servant to take care of your food and shelter?" Luo Chengyun tilted his head and smiled.
"Young Master Chengyun, it's not that …" Huang Ge denied with a trace of sobbing.
Luo Chengyun simply didn't listen to Huang Ge's explanation. He smiled and said: "Although Luo Zheng was demoted to a servant, in any case, his surname is Luo, and he was once the young master of the Luo Family. Even if I take him as a servant, it's not appropriate. You must have burned your brain to do this kind of senseless thing. You deserved to be beaten."
Huang Ge kowtowed and continued to cry: "Young Master Chengyun, this time I was wrong, but you still have to make a decision for me …" As he cried, he quietly made a gesture to the side.
A middle-aged woman about forty years old next to him silently walked to Huang Ge's side and knelt down as well.
This middle-aged woman was Huang Ge's wife and also Luo Chengyun's wet nurse. She had taken care of Luo Chengyun since he was young. Luo Chengyun's mother died when he was young, but he had a very good relationship with this wet nurse, as if they were mother and son.
"Second Mother, you don't need to kneel. Huang Ge, you also stand up!" Luo Chengyun waved his hand.
Huang Ge's voice trembled: "Young Master Chengyun, do you agree?"
Luo Chengyun stood up from the chair, walked two steps, and said: "Cousin Peiran previously said that he would spare Luo Zheng's life so that he could keep him alive and watch over him. However, Luo Zheng isn't an important person. Now that Cousin Peiran is about to leave for the Blue Cloud Sect, I'll help Cousin Peiran get rid of him! "
Hearing this, Huang Ge's deformed mouth opened and said: "Thank you, Young Master Chengyun!"
"However, this matter still needs to wait." Luo Chengyun touched his head and said: "I've just swallowed the last Heaven and Earth Fortune Pill of the clan. This month, I'm going to go into seclusion to refine the pill's efficacy and cleanse my body. How about we wait until the Clan Refinement Day in a month? On that day, I'll choose him as my opponent and kill him with my own hands."
After saying this, Luo Chengyun's face emitted layers of killing intent.
The Clan Refinement Day was also the day when the Luo Clan's disciples would inspect their strength. On that day, the Luo Clan's elders would appear and inspect the results of the Luo Clan's disciples' cultivation.
At the same time, the Clan Refinement Day was also an opportunity for human targets.
As long as they could survive the deathmatch environment on the Clan Refinement Day, they would regain their freedom.
Even the lowliest human targets had the right to desire freedom. If they couldn't see the dawn of freedom, they wouldn't be able to withstand the pressure of being beaten every day and would quickly die.
The purpose of setting this rule was to give all the human targets a glimmer of hope. They hoped that they could survive the deathmatch on the Clan Refinement Day and walk out of the Luo Clan, no longer having to be a lowly human target.
However, the "deathmatch" environment itself was unfair. The human targets were often beaten every day and suffered all kinds of injuries and injuries. How could they fight against the well-trained elite disciples of the Luo Clan?
Who knew how many human targets had been beaten to death on the Clan Refinement Day. That day was the day when the Luo Clan's elders would inspect the strength of the Luo Clan's disciples. According to their strength, they would give a certain amount of rewards. Every Luo Clan disciple would go all out, and it was also the time when they hit the hardest.
"Okay, Young Master Chengyun. Then let that brat Luo Zheng live for another month!" Huang Ge kowtowed a few more times before rolling and crawling up from the ground. His eyes under the gauze revealed an ominous glint of hatred.
After Luo Chengyun left, the middle-aged woman tried to persuade Huang Ge: "That Luo Zheng is quite pitiful. Why do you have to force him to death? He shouldn't have beaten you, but it's enough to teach him a lesson. "
Huang Ge said: "You're just a woman. Besides being soft-hearted, what else do you know?"

Chapter 6
A large bucket of cold water was poured on Luo Zheng's body. Milky white impurities flowed along with the water to the ground.
After entering the Bone Refining stage, his body no longer had any impurities. Now what was being forced out of his body were the milky white impurities in his bones.
After washing away the impurities, Luo Zheng felt refreshed all over.
These days, Steward Fang no longer dared to trouble him. This gave Luo Zheng more space.
At night, Luo Zheng lifted the iron bed up and pressed it against the cellar's stone wall. Then he wrapped the bed frame with layers of cotton wool, making a simple wooden dummy.
Because the bed frame was pressed against the cellar's stone wall, most of the force was absorbed by the thick stone wall. This way, the iron bed would not be broken apart by Luo Zheng's punches. And because of the cotton wool, the sound of his punches was reduced to the minimum. In addition, he was in the cellar, so people outside could not know that he was secretly cultivating.
The Red Sandalwood Fist he used had been passed down in the Luo family for hundreds of years. It was a unique skill of the Luo family that was not passed down to outsiders. Even collateral descendants were not easily taught.
After entering the Bone Refining stage, he could now easily use the moves of the Red Sandalwood Fist that he could not practice before.
"Red Sandalwood One-Inch Punch!"
"Bang bang bang bang bang!"
Seven muffled sounds came from the stone wall.
The Red Sandalwood One-Inch Punch was the most profound move of the Red Sandalwood Fist. One strike of the One-Inch Punch could cause multiple injuries. The number of injuries could show how well the One-Inch Punch was used.
Luo Zheng wasn't too satisfied with the result of the seven muffled bangs, which meant that he had caused seven damages.
His father once told Luo Zheng that when he was in the Bone Refining stage, he could cause eight injuries. Now Luo Zheng, who was also in the Bone Refining stage, could only cause seven injuries. His understanding of the Red Sandalwood One-Inch Punch was not deep enough. It seemed that he had to work harder!
Punches after punches landed on the cotton wadding, producing muffled sounds.
After entering the Bone Refining stage, Luo Zheng's strength also increased crazily.
Luo Peiran had already entered the peak of the Bone Refining stage. The strength of each punch was more than 500 kilograms.
And Luo Zheng had just entered the Bone Refining stage. He estimated that his fist strength was about 700 to 800 kilograms.
This bit of strength was still not enough.
The most important thing was that Luo Zheng wanted to enter the Blue Cloud Sect.
When he thought about how his younger sister was currently facing the wall in Purgatory Mountain, Luo Zheng felt as if there was a rock weighing down on his heart.
Luo Yan had always been obedient and wouldn't cause any trouble. He must have been harmed by evil people. He had to enter the Blue Cloud Sect as soon as possible. Only then could he protect Luo Yan.
"Bam, bam, bam, bam!" His punches increased in strength.
The Blue Cloud Sect was the largest sect in the Imperial Capital. Every year, it would recruit disciples from all over the Imperial Capital.
The Blue Cloud Sect was also the biggest goal of all the young people in the Imperial Capital. It gathered the best cultivation resources in the Imperial Capital and had the most powerful experts to guide them.
However, the conditions to enter the Blue Cloud Sect were extremely harsh.
Or, they had outstanding talent, such as his sister Luo Yan, who had been accepted as an exception.
Or, they had great strength and stood out among the young people. Just the strength of the Bone Refining Realm might not be enough.
"Right now, I am being tempered by someone. The speed of my body's advancement is changing with each passing day. However, if I want to quickly advance in a short period of time, I still need to cultivate bitterly!"
When he thought of this, he smashed the stone wall with force again.
Luo Zheng originally had a heart that pursued the peak of the martial dao. In the past, he was meticulous and worked hard step by step. Even his father praised his son's perseverance.
However, after his father died, he was demoted to a servant. His mental state suffered a great blow, which was why his progress on the martial dao stagnated.
However, the current Luo Zheng already picked up this confidence again. For the sake of his goal, he pursued it with all his might.
That night, he almost didn't sleep.
He didn't know how many times he punched. Under Luo Zheng's punches, the cotton wool was already tightly stuck to the wall. He had no choice but to tear off the cotton wool and gently pull it apart with his hands. Only then could it return to its original state.
During the day, it was still endless punches and endless tempering.
In order to cultivate as soon as possible, Luo Zheng became more active even when he was being beaten.
He took the initiative to ask the Luo Clan's disciples to beat him. There was a risk of being discovered.
After all, after being beaten so many times, there was not a single injury on his body. It was easy for people to be suspicious.
However, Luo Zheng didn't care so much. Only by being beaten as much as possible could he temper himself as soon as possible and improve his strength as soon as possible.
Some of the Luo Clan's disciples were indeed puzzled. Luo Zheng had been beaten more and more frequently during this period of time, but his spirit was getting better and better. How did he look like someone who was being beaten? Instead, he looked like someone who was beating people up!
However, when they thought of how Luo Zheng had been a human target for two years and still lived until now, they could describe him as tenacious. These Luo Clan's disciples were not interested in delving into the mystery of a human target. After all, they cultivated to beat people up, not to be beaten. Even if Luo Zheng had some special defensive skills, they were too lazy to know.
During this period of time, Luo Zheng's bones had been cleansed more and more of the impurities. As long as he took a bath, the water flowing on the ground would immediately become milky white, as rich as milk.
The impurities that were being tempered out by the warm current every day were almost equivalent to the impurities of others who cultivated for several months. This meant that one day of his being beaten was equivalent to several months of cultivation for others. This cultivation speed was like a miracle!
During the day, he was beaten, and at night, he practiced martial arts. He practiced diligently without stopping for a moment.
During this period of time, the total amount of time he slept was probably less than twenty hours, but his spirit was not tired at all. His eyes were as clear as ever.
The reason why he was so full of spirit was most likely because of the mysterious "Nine Dragons Furnace" in his mind. That day, his soul had been refined by the Nine Dragons Furnace. His soul had been broken thousands of times, and every time it was broken, he would rather die than live.
But after that kind of pain, his spirit had always been very good. Presumably, his soul had also been tempered!
In the human body, the most difficult thing to cultivate was the soul. Everyone could train the body, even those who did not cultivate martial arts could train the body.
But the soul was hidden deep in the human body's secret realm. It could not be seen or touched, just like the illusory shore in the Buddhist gatha. Ordinary people could not train at all.
It was said that in the Blue Cloud Sect, there were some secret books of a higher level that could affect people's souls, such as the "Soul Training Technique".
Luo Zheng could not touch these mysterious realms, so he did not think too much about it. Since he did not need to sleep, he could use this time to cultivate.
In the blink of an eye, more than twenty days had passed.
"Bang!"
Luo Zheng's punch had cracked the thick stone wall of the cellar.
He had only used seventy percent of his strength in this punch, but the power was already so terrifying. If he had not held back, the cellar would have been destroyed by his punch.
After half a month of tempering, Luo Zheng's strength had advanced again.
From the middle stage of the Bone Refining Stage to the peak stage of the Bone Refining Stage, the strength of one hand could reach a thousand jin. A thousand jin was the strength of one cauldron.
For martial artists, the strength of one cauldron was a watershed. Only after reaching the strength of one cauldron could one be considered to have reached the threshold and officially stepped onto the path of martial arts.
In less than a month, from the peak stage of the Flesh Refining Stage to the peak stage of the Bone Refining Stage, he had crossed an entire level. Not to mention that this cultivation speed had never appeared in the Luo Clan, even in the entire Empire, it would be difficult to find a second person.
After all, using the Body Refining method to temper out the impurities relied on perseverance and persistence. It relied on decades of cultivation, and the amount of impurities that could be refined every day was pitifully small.
But using the Body Refining method to "hammer" out the impurities in the body, the speed was more than a hundred or a thousand times faster …
But today, when he was being beaten, he felt that his body seemed to have undergone some changes.
Although he didn't feel any pain from the punches and kicks he usually received, he could still feel some weight. Today, he discovered that the strength of the Luo Clan's fists seemed to have become lighter.
Luo Zheng secretly observed for a moment. The Luo Clan's disciples who were beating him didn't hold back, but why did he feel this way?
Not only that, but the warm current produced by each punch on his body had also decreased by a lot.
If it was said that a punch in the past could produce a warm current the size of a thumb, then now a punch could only produce a warm current the size of a little finger. With the lack of warm current, the efficiency of washing the body naturally decreased.
This night, after returning to the cellar and taking a bath, he discovered that the impurities that had been forced out of his body had clearly decreased by about half.
These changes caused a trace of worry to arise in Luo Zheng's heart. What exactly had gone wrong?
Could it be that his body had hardened?
According to the records of the mysterious Weapon Refining Cultivation Method, his current physical strength was comparable to a Low Grade Profound Weapon.
After a Profound Weapon underwent continuous tempering, its strength would gradually increase. Once the strength increased to a certain extent, the tempering effect of ordinary strength wouldn't be as good.
The majority of the Luo Clan's disciples in the Drill Hall were in the Skin Refining Realm. Even Luo Dalong was in the Skin Refining Realm. It was only because of his innate divine strength that his strength was comparable to that of a Flesh Refining Realm cultivator.
Now, several hundred pounds of strength was no longer effective on Luo Zheng's body. It seemed that he had to find someone more powerful to beat him to produce an effect.
But where could he find Luo Zheng? He couldn't let the Luo Clan's elders do it … …
"In a few days, it will be the Clan Refining Day. During the Clan Refining Day, the Luo Clan's disciples will exert their full strength. The strength of their punches should also increase by a lot.
