More importantly, if I can defeat my opponent in a deathmatch on the Clan Refining Day, I can legitimately abandon my status as a servant and leave the Luo Clan openly."
With Luo Zheng's current physical strength, those Luo Clan's disciples simply couldn't shake him. So what if they fought for a day and a night?
In the cellar, Luo Zheng's bright eyes blinked. Under the illumination of the candlelight, his face revealed a resolute expression.

Chapter 7
After this year's winter, cold air blew in from the boundless land of ice in the north, dyeing most of the empire's territory with a layer of white.
Heavy snow covered the ground like cotton quilts. The spacious drill ground in front of the Luo family was covered with thick snow.
On the day of the Clan Competition, the servants of the Luo family cleaned up the snow on the drill ground. Twelve branches of the Luo family stood in neat rows on the drill ground, waiting for the elders of the Luo family to inspect them.
Originally, there were thirteen branches of the Luo family, but now only twelve teams were present. This was because the branch of the eldest branch had ceased to exist two years ago.
In order to urge the Luo family's disciples to practice diligently, the Clan Competition was held once a year. Whether it was the Luo family's disciples or the human targets, this day was an important day for them.
According to the performance of the Luo family's disciples on the day of the Clan Competition, their allocation of resources for the next year would be decided. Those who performed well would naturally receive more resources, such as body-refining pills that could increase their cultivation speed, rejuvenation pills that could rapidly heal injuries, and so on.
For the human targets, this day could decide their life and death and freedom.
Luo Zheng and the other human targets also entered the drill ground. Today, the human targets' expressions were very serious, as if they were ready to risk everything. Today was too important for them.
For the human targets, there were only two choices in the deathmatch. If they won, they would gain freedom. If they lost, they would die.
But for the Luo family's disciples, the deathmatch was just a test. If they won, they would receive rewards and support from the family. If they lost, they would just lose some face.
Many of the aristocratic family's disciples were very strong. Whether it was in terms of cultivation methods or strength, they were not inferior to others. However, because many of the aristocratic family's disciples had little actual combat experience, they would often drop the ball at crucial moments. Losing to someone weaker than them was a common occurrence.
The original intention of the deathmatch was to force the human targets into a dead end, stimulate their potential to the maximum, and then fight with the Luo family's disciples to the death. Only in this way could the Luo family's disciples be given real combat training.
Before long, a middle-aged man wearing a green robe came out from the high platform of the drill ground. The middle-aged man had a long beard and a jade-like face. He was Luo Zheng's third uncle, Luo Junyi.
Seeing this person, Luo Zheng's eyes flashed with a cold light. This person was one of the murderers who had killed his father. This person looked like a modest gentleman, but he used a vicious scheme to murder his elder brother. He was indeed a hypocrite.
If it wasn't for the fact that his strength was insufficient, Luo Zheng would have skinned this person alive. Unfortunately, Luo Junyi was a Viscera Refining Stage expert. His internal organs had been fully tempered, and his strength had reached the strength of three cauldrons. He could tear apart tigers and leopards with his bare hands, and smash a city wall with his bare fists!
After Luo Junyi stood on the high platform, he took a deep breath and said softly, "Today, I have good news for everyone. Our Luo family's young master, my nephew Peiran, has been accepted by the Blue Cloud Sect as an inner sect disciple."
Luo Junyi's voice wasn't loud, but everyone heard it clearly. After entering the Viscera Refining Stage, one's internal organs would be tempered, and their breathing would become extremely long.
Hearing his words, all of the Luo family's disciples revealed an envious expression.
Actually, Luo Peiran being accepted by the Blue Cloud Sect was expected. However, the Blue Cloud Sect's disciples were divided into many levels. Many people had passed through many layers of tests and stood out from many competitors, but they had only managed to fight for the position of an outer sect disciple.
However, Luo Peiran was actually able to reach the heavens in a single bound and become an inner sect disciple. This matter was beyond everyone's expectations. It was no wonder that they were envious.
Luo Zheng's body also shook. The Fortune Pill was actually so miraculous that it could directly send Luo Peiran to the Blue Cloud Sect's inner sect. His fists were clenched tightly, and his heart was filled with worry.
Second Uncle and Third Uncle didn't get rid of him because they didn't think he was a threat to the Luo family. However, they definitely wouldn't let Luo Yan off. Previously, Luo Yan had escaped because he was in the Blue Cloud Sect. Now that Luo Peiran had actually become an inner sect disciple of the Blue Cloud Sect, it would definitely be disadvantageous to her. I must immediately go to the Blue Cloud Sect!
"Nephew Peiran is the pride of our family. Everyone must set him as a goal. Today is the Family Training Day. The Luo family's disciples will each choose a human target to fight to the death. If you win the battle, the" Cultivation Pill "distributed next year will be doubled, and your monthly allowance will also be doubled. In addition, you will also receive a Violet Pill …"
This reward was very attractive to many of the branch family's disciples. Therefore, when it was announced, many of the Luo family's disciples immediately began to discuss it fervently …
The human targets' expressions became even more serious. The more generous the reward, the more ruthless the Luo family's disciples would be, and the smaller the chance of survival for the human targets.
After Luo Junyi finished speaking, he sat down on a chair on the high platform. At this time, Chief Steward Huang Ge jumped onto the high platform. His eyes swept over the human targets and locked onto Luo Zheng. A vicious light flashed in his eyes. He thought to himself, Boy, you won't live past today!
Then, Huang Ge said in a high-pitched voice, "Now, the Luo family's disciples will choose their own targets. The first Luo family's disciple to fight is the eldest son of the third branch, Luo Chengyun!"
Luo Chengyun jumped onto the middle of the Drill Ground. After bowing to his father, Luo Junyi, he turned around to choose a human target.
When Luo Chengyun's eyes fell on Luo Zheng's head, their eyes met. A smile appeared on the corner of Luo Zheng's mouth. A month ago, he had beaten up Huang Ge. He had thought that Luo Chengyun would immediately retaliate against him. He hadn't expected that this month would be so peaceful. It seemed that Luo Chengyun had been waiting for this day. He would choose me as his mortal target and beat me to death in the arena?
However, Luo Chengyun didn't choose Luo Zheng. Instead, he chose a stocky man behind Luo Zheng.
This was beyond Luo Zheng's expectations …
The stocky middle-aged man was a death row prisoner that the Luo family had just bought. Therefore, he hadn't suffered any serious internal injuries. His complexion was good, and his strength wasn't bad either. He had reached the Flesh Refining Stage.
After the middle-aged man was chosen, he jumped onto the arena without saying a word. His eyes were full of ferocity. As a human target, everyone knew very well that a mortal battle was a fight with no way out. Retreating was a dead end for a human target. Instead of sitting and waiting for death, it was better to fight with all their strength. Maybe they could fight for a way out.
In a mortal battle, there wasn't so much etiquette.
After the middle-aged man got on the arena, he took the initiative to strike first. He gathered all the strength in his body and rushed toward Luo Chengyun. This middle-aged man relied on his sturdy muscles to rush forward like a bull. The dark ironstone arena made a thumping sound as he stepped on it.
A faint smile appeared on Luo Chengyun's face. A purple light condensed in his hand. His fingers formed the shape of a bow. When the middle-aged man rushed to Luo Chengyun's side, Luo Chengyun lightly and skillfully moved aside. A Purple Sandalwood One-inch Punch hit the middle-aged man from the side.
"Pu!"
The Purple Sandalwood One-inch Punch's strength was subtle and not obvious. The middle-aged man stopped his footsteps. Since he didn't hit Luo Chengyun this time, he turned around and prepared to do it again. He was completely unaware that he had been injured by Luo Chengyun.
But just as he took a step forward, six muffled bursting sounds came from his body. Suddenly, six bloody holes appeared on the middle-aged man's body.
His eyes were as big as a cow's, and his face was full of confusion and unwillingness. His mouth made a gurgling sound, but he couldn't speak. Then, his eyes gradually lost their light and he fell to the ground.
Killed in one move …
The Luo Family's disciples present burst into cheers. Many people took the lead in applauding.
There were also many Luo Family's disciples who saw this scene. They seemed to understand something, and their expressions were a little indifferent.
As the eldest son of the third branch, Luo Chengyun's cultivation talent was considered outstanding in the Luo Family. He had been enshrined with all kinds of elixirs since he was young, so his cultivation speed was much faster than the average Luo Family's disciples.
But it was impossible for his cultivation speed to be so fast. The only explanation was that he had eaten the Luo Family's second and last Worldly Creation Elixir.
Luo Zheng shook his head in the human target, a wry smile on his face. Second and Third Uncles didn't treat him as an outsider. No one in the Luo Family had dared to touch the Worldly Creation Elixir for several generations. After they took the throne, they each took one and divided it up …
Well, well, well. The first time he heard Luo Peiran say that he had eaten the Worldly Creation Elixir, he was very angry. But now, Luo Zheng's mood was very calm.
Although the Worldly Creation Elixir was wonderful, there was only one. It was gone after eating it.
But Luo Zheng's special constitution could continuously cleanse his body. In comparison, the Worldly Creation Elixir was dispensable. Luo Zheng didn't care about it now. But the actions of Second and Third Uncles made the Luo Family's disciples too bitterly disappointed.
At this moment, Huang Ge's voice sounded, "The first deathmatch, Young Master Chengyun wins!"
Luo Chengyun moved his wrists and said to Huang Ge on the high platform, "Chief Steward, the challenge just now was just a test. I still want to challenge another person."
Huang Ge's face lit up. He thought that it was finally time. So he said, "Young Master Chengyun, if you still want to challenge another person, you can choose your own target."
Luo Chengyun turned his head in the arena and pointed his finger at the human targets. Seeing Luo Chengyun's finger, the human targets' faces turned pale. They had seen Luo Chengyun's strength just now. If they were chosen by this guy, they would definitely die. Luo Chengyun's finger was like the scythe of the Grim Reaper. Whoever's head fell on by Luo Chengyun's finger could meet the King of Hell.
Finally, Luo Chengyun's eyes stopped on Luo Zheng. He hooked his finger and said with a smile, "You, come up!"
Everyone looked in the direction of Luo Chengyun's finger and saw that the target Luo Chengyun had chosen was actually Luo Zheng!
For the human targets, a deathmatch was a situation that would not end until one of them died. Either they won or they died.
Therefore, in the previous Clan Days, when the Luo Family's disciples chose their targets, they intentionally or unintentionally avoided Luo Zheng. Although Luo Zheng bore the crime of betraying the family, the Luo Family's disciples did not dare to really kill him if the Family Head did not order him to be executed.
But today, Luo Chengyun actually chose Luo Zheng. People with discerning eyes already understood that Luo Zheng was probably going to die today.
"Finally!"
Luo Zheng did not say anything. He walked out from the human targets and climbed up the arena expressionlessly. He cupped his hands and said to Luo Chengyun, "Young Master Chengyun, please!"
"Big Cousin, why do you call me like an outsider?" Luo Chengyun narrowed his eyes and said.

Chapter 8
Eldest cousin brother …
Luo Zheng hasn't heard this name for a long time.
He remembered that when he was young, Luo Chengyun often ran behind Luo Zheng and often called him "Big Cousin Brother, Big Cousin Brother".
If someone bullied Luo Chengyun, he would come crying to Luo Zheng.
Calling him like this brings back memories of Luo Zheng's childhood. How beautiful those times were.
He didn't expect that when he grew up, there would be internal strife in the family. Brothers gradually drifted apart for their own interests. It could be considered a great tragedy in the world.
Luo Zheng nods and changes the way he calls Luo Zheng back: "Cousin Chengyun, let's do it!"
"Alas, Luo Zheng, they all say that you don't know your own identity. It seems that this saying is true. Just because I call you 'eldest cousin brother', you really think I'm your cousin brother? Haha! It won't be an injustice for you to die in my hands. "After saying this, Luo Chengyun's sneering face suddenly exudes a powerful momentum.
Being teased by Luo Chengyun's words, Luo Zheng's heart surges with anger and his face turns cold. The trace of remaining familial affection in his heart is obliterated at this point!
As soon as Luo Chengyun finishes speaking, his whole body surges with purple light. With a sliding step, he rushes towards Luo Zheng at an extremely strange speed.
"Bang!"
Luo Zheng takes the punch head-on. His body retreats a few steps before he can stabilize himself. The power of this blow has unexpectedly broken through one ding. It seems that Luo Chengyun has also entered the Bone Refining stage with the help of the Heaven and Earth Fortune Elixir.
The power of one ding is really powerful and overbearing. Before, Luo Zheng's body was already hard enough. Those Skin Refining stage and Flesh Refining stage cultivators couldn't produce much warm current when beating him.
But after taking Luo Chengyun's blow, the warm current in his body begins to circulate crazily again. It rushes to Luo Zheng's bones from head to toe and continuously cleanses them.
This feeling is too cool!
While Luo Zheng is secretly enjoying himself, Luo Chengyun on the other side is like a madman. He doesn't want to give Luo Zheng a chance to breathe at all and rushes towards Luo Zheng again.
Straight Punch, Straight Punch, Burst Punch.
Elbow strike, side kick, cross kick …
All kinds of fierce attacks were thrown at Luo Zheng with all their might.
Warm currents flowed between Luo Zheng's bones like floodwaters. Luo Zheng could even clearly feel that the impurities in his bones were being squeezed out of his bones one by one under the scouring of the warm currents.
"Well done! Young Master Chengyun, beat him to death just like that! " Huang Ge shouted back and forth on the high platform. His expression was extremely excited. It was as if he was more excited than when he personally went up to the arena and beat up Luo Zheng.
Many of the Luo Family's disciples were cheering for Luo Chengyun. However, most of them were silent at the moment.
Most of the Luo Family disciples at the bottom of the hierarchy still missed the Luo Family of the past. Back then, the Luo Family was fair and compassionate. They treated every Luo Family disciple fairly. As long as you had enough talent, no matter which branch you were from, everyone would have a chance to succeed.
However, after the second branch and the third branch ascended to the top, except for the people from the second branch and the third branch, other disciples from the collateral branches simply could not see any hope.
Luo Zheng, the former young master, was also the last remaining member of the former Luo Family. If he died, it meant that the former Luo Family would never return.
In the arena, Luo Zheng was constantly being beaten up by Luo Chengyun.
Luo Junyi, who was sitting on the side and watching the fight, frowned. As his father, he was very clear about Chengyun's strength. After taking the Heaven and Earth Fortune Elixir and entering the Bone Refining Stage, Chengyun's strength had already broken through by one ding.
In the Luo Family, except for Luo Peiran, there was no other Luo Family disciple of the younger generation who could be Chengyun's opponent.
He had counted very clearly just now. Luo Chengyun had already punched dozens of times in one breath. Although his punches were full of strength and vigorous like a tiger, and Luo Zheng was beaten back little by little and had no power to fight back.
However, why hadn't Luo Zheng fallen down yet?
On the path of martial arts, there was a saying that offense was the best defense.
That was because offense was far easier than defense. No matter how strong one's body was, it would not be able to withstand a sharp attack.
Not to mention others, even Luo Junyi's body would not be able to withstand Luo Chengyun's beating. This was also the reason why those body-tempering cultivation techniques, such as the "Vajra Cover" and the "Nine Yang Saint Body", were so precious.
Luo Zheng was beaten up like this by Luo Chengyun, yet he was still able to stand up …
Could it be that Luo Zheng had obtained some special body-tempering cultivation technique? Or perhaps his big brother had some reservations and passed this cultivation technique to Luo Zheng before his death?
When he thought of the fact that Luo Zheng was still jumping around after being beaten for two years, Luo Junyi's eyes lit up!
Under the constant beating, Luo Chengyun became somewhat impatient. His attacks became heavier and heavier, and all kinds of ruthless moves were used on Luo Zheng's body.
"Purple Sandalwood Inch Force!"
"Bang Bang Bang Bang Bang!"
He originally thought that the destructive power of the Purple Sandalwood Inch Force would be able to make Luo Zheng fall down. However, after the six layers of force exploded in Luo Zheng's body, Luo Zheng still stood up. His eyes became brighter and brighter as he stared straight at Luo Chengyun. This made Luo Chengyun's hair stand on end.
Was this guy a monster? How could he not die after being beaten like this?
Seeing Luo Zheng's gaze, Luo Chengyun's eyes revealed a panicked expression. He was already an expert in the Bone Refining Stage, and his strength had broken through one cauldron. It was reasonable to say that he should be able to smash a guy like Luo Zheng with a single fist. Why was this happening?
What was the meaning of this gaze? Was he mocking his own incompetence?
Luo Zheng's gaze not only made Luo Chengyun panic, but also incomparably angry.
It seems that I have to use that move to serve you! Luo Chengyun quietly took out a small box from his clothes. The small box was the size of a palm, but it was engraved with brilliant and colorful talismans. There was also a trigger behind the small box. He pointed the front of the small box at Luo Zheng and fiercely pulled the trigger behind the box. With a ferocious expression, he roared, "Go to hell!"
The moment Luo Chengyun took out the small box, Luo Zheng became alert. As the young master of the family, he certainly recognized that it was the family's most precious defensive treasure, the Thousand Revolutions Tribulation Thunder Halberd!
This kind of Thousand Revolutions Tribulation Thunder Halberd was a secret weapon made by talisman masters. A Thousand Revolutions Tribulation Thunder Halberd was sealed with talismans. It was extremely powerful and could kill the enemy in one blow if the enemy was caught off guard!
However, this Thousand Revolutions Tribulation Thunder Halberd was a one-time consumable item, and its price was extremely high. After using it once, it would be useless. Generally, it was given to the younger generation of the family for self-defense.
This Luo Chengyun was actually so vicious. In a situation where his attack failed, he actually wanted to use such a vicious thing to deal with him. Although his body was tough, it would be extremely difficult for him to survive if he was hit by this Thunder Halberd. Luo Zheng was thoroughly angry.
A Thunder Halberd formed by lightning shot out from the Thousand Revolutions Tribulation Thunder Halberd and went straight to Luo Zheng.
At the critical moment, he dodged and rolled on the ground. The Thunder Halberd, with crackling lightning, swept over Luo Zheng's head and burned a few strands of Luo Zheng's hair.
Subsequently, a human target under the ring screamed. That human target was hit by the Thunder Halberd head-on, and its whole body was ignited with raging flames. The fierce fire instantly burned the human target into charcoal!
Seeing the miserable state of the human target, everyone's face turned ugly. This Luo Chengyun had gone too far. Just now, his Thunder Halberd could have hit anyone on the Drill Ground. What if it didn't hit the human target, but a member of the Luo family? Luo Chengyun simply didn't take the lives of the other members of the Luo family seriously.
Luo Zheng got up from the ground. His cold face seemed to be frozen. He clenched his fists and said, "After fighting for so long, are you satisfied now? Is it my turn now? "
"Not good!" Seeing the sudden change in the ring, Luo Junyi slapped the table and stood up. He was about to jump down from the high platform and rush into the ring. He had already noticed the abnormality in Luo Zheng's body. This vicious boy must have been planning for a long time to live in humiliation!
Unfortunately, no matter how fast Luo Junyi was, there was still some distance between the high platform and the ring. This little bit of time was enough for Luo Zheng to make his move.
"Purple Sandalwood Inch Punch."
Before Luo Chengyun could recover, he was hit by Luo Zheng's fist. Luo Zheng's punch was very clever. The Inch Punch blasted into Luo Chengyun's body, and in an instant, it exploded seven times.
"Puff, puff, puff, puff, puff."
After seven muffled sounds, seven bloody holes burst out from several parts of Luo Chengyun's body. They were the roots of his arms and legs, as well as his dantian and Qi acupoints.
These parts wouldn't harm Luo Chengyun's life, but it would make it difficult for him to cultivate again for the rest of his life.
One move!
The insufferably arrogant second young master of the Luo family was crippled by Luo Zheng.
The Luo family's Drill Ground was completely silent.
Who would have thought that the human target that people beat up at will on ordinary days would have such strength?
Some of the Luo family's disciples who had offended Luo Zheng suddenly felt a chill run down their spines. They thought that Luo Zheng was easy to bully. They didn't expect that he was actually hiding such terrifying strength.
He defeated Luo Chengyun with only one move. What about himself?
Luo Chengyun's face was full of disbelief. He thought that with his Bone Refining stage strength, dealing with Luo Zheng would be as simple as dealing with a three-year-old child. But why was Luo Zheng suddenly so strong? He had taken the Heaven and Earth Fortune Elixir, so his cultivation speed was many times faster than Luo Zheng's …
Luo Chengyun fell back with deep unwillingness. Luo Junyi rushed over in time and supported him. "Chengyun, my son! Are you all right? "
"I didn't hurt his vital parts. He won't die," said Luo Zheng.
Luo Junyi raised his head. His gentle and elegant face was already distorted. He pointed at Luo Zheng's nose and scolded: "You vicious little bastard, why did you hurt my son?"
"Fists and feet have no eyes. Life and death are up to fate. Not to mention that this was a deathmatch. In the past, many Luo family's disciples were injured by human targets in the ring. Third Uncle, you should know better than me!" Luo Zheng said seriously: "Now that I've defeated Luo Chengyun, according to the rules, I'm no longer a human target. I can leave the Luo family freely!"
"Hahahaha, I let you live because of my benevolence. I didn't expect you to grow to this point." Luo Junyi put Luo Chengyun down on one side and laughed loudly: "You think I'll let you go? Don't be delusional! "
Luo Zheng's face darkened. He asked: "Third Uncle, according to the rules of the family, I can leave the Luo family after winning the deathmatch …"
"Rules?" Luo Junyi interrupted Luo Zheng's words. His distorted face showed a mocking expression. "Only your useless father would follow the rules of the family. Let me tell you, what are the rules? In the Luo family, I am the rules! "
Hearing his Third Uncle's words, Luo Zheng's face twitched twice.
He wanted to swallow the man in front of him alive all the time, but he kept reminding himself to control his emotions. He must be patient.
Because he knew his strength was not enough. If he wanted to take revenge, he needed to leave the Luo family and give himself time to grow!
He thought he could leave justifiably after winning the deathmatch. He didn't expect that Luo Junyi didn't intend to reason with him at all.

Chapter 9
"Luo Zheng, it's a bit too much for you to insult your elders like this …" An elder of the Luo family said with a frown.
"Shut up!" Luo Zheng scolded, "When my father was murdered, what were you, the third, fourth, and fifth branches … the entire Luo family doing at that time? Are you worthy of the favor my father gave you? You're helping the tyrant, you're all accomplices in the murder of my father! "
The anger and injustice he had endured for two years finally erupted at this moment. Luo Zheng's voice was fierce, like an angry demon god, looking down on everyone in front of him. Everyone who saw Luo Zheng's eyes either avoided or lowered their heads, not daring to meet his eyes.
Luo Junyi didn't intend to continue this topic with Luo Zheng. "I'm not going to talk nonsense with you, little bastard. Hand over your body protection technique, and I'll allow you to kill yourself on the spot. I'll let you die painlessly, and I'll leave your body intact and bury you in the Luo family's ancestral grave." Then, a purple light as fine as hair extended from his arm.
"You're actually still coveting my body protection technique? In your dreams! " Then, Luo Zheng's feet stepped on the edge of the arena, and he rushed out with extreme speed. Since he couldn't leave in a dignified manner, he could only fight his way out.
Luo Zheng's speed was fast, but Luo Junyi's was even faster. After all, Luo Junyi was a famous expert who had entered the Viscera Refining stage for a long time. When he ran, he left behind a purple afterimage. He arrived in front of Luo Zheng and said, "Little bastard, your strength is not enough to see, you can't escape. I'll say it one more time, hand over your body protection technique! Otherwise, I'll let you suffer all kinds of torture, and then I'll grind your bones and scatter your ashes. You'll die without a burial place. "
"Get lost!"
What answered Luo Junyi was Luo Zheng's iron fist!
Facing Luo Zheng's attack, Luo Junyi didn't put it in his eyes at all. He stretched out his hand and lightly pushed away the strength of Luo Zheng's fist. At the same time, he got close to Luo Zheng's body and threw dozens of short punches in a breath.
Luo Junyi's strength was far from what the Luo Family disciples could compare with. A Bone Refining stage disciple's strength could reach one ding of strength, while a Viscera Refining stage disciple could reach three ding of strength!
The terrifying power of the fist poured into Luo Zheng's body. His body crazily transformed into a warm current. However, the power of the fist was too great, exceeding the limit of Luo Zheng's transformation. There was still a part of the power that he couldn't transform in time. It was this remaining power that injured Luo Zheng.
"Pu!"
Luo Zheng was sent flying and smashed into the ground. He immediately stood up and spat out a mouthful of blood.
Seeing that Luo Zheng could still stand up after taking so many punches from him, Luo Junyi's heart was also burning: "This protective cultivation method is really amazing. Hand it over, and I can consider letting you live in the Luo family!"
"You despicable people speak like farts. Do you think I'll believe you?" Luo Zheng said as he adjusted his breathing. After landing, Luo Zheng felt that the bones in his body were incomparably light. It seemed that after Luo Chengyun and Luo Junyi's tempering, the warm current had already washed away the impurities in his bones!
After a month of tempering, Luo Zheng had already stepped into the peak of the Bone Refining stage. However, because his body's strength had increased and the Luo Family disciples' strength was insufficient, he lacked the warm current to cleanse his bones, making it difficult for him to break through.
However, after being beaten up by Luo Chengyun and Luo Junyi, a large amount of warm current was produced in his body. It actually helped Luo Zheng temper the remaining impurities in his bones.
Now that the impurities in his bones had been cleansed, every bone in his body was incomparably pure.
At this moment, he felt that his body was incomparably light. Every bone in his body had spirituality, allowing him to freely control them. The frequency of his breathing had also changed. Every time he breathed, it took half as long as before. His breathing was long and continuous, and he could breathe in and out freely.
This was the sign of stepping into the Viscera Refining stage!
Power, a strong power poured into Luo Zheng's body. He was incomparably ecstatic, but his face did not show it.
"Stubborn! I hope that when we torture you later, your mouth can still be so stubborn! "Luo Junyi once again approached. This time, he wanted to capture Luo Zheng in one fell swoop.
However, at this moment, an astonishing scene appeared!
The moment Luo Junyi got close, Luo Zheng threw out a punch at lightning speed.
The speed of this punch was extremely fast. Luo Junyi was caught off guard and this punch hit him directly.
After entering the Viscera Refining stage, Luo Zheng's control of his bones had already reached perfection. The power he could display was far from what a Bone Refining stage martial artist could compare with. However, Luo Junyi did not know that Luo Zheng had stepped into the Viscera Refining stage. He had a wrong estimation of Luo Zheng's strength.
When this punch landed on Luo Junyi's body, Luo Junyi was immediately sent flying three zhang away. He rolled several times on the ground before he could get up.
"You, you actually stepped into the Viscera Refining stage!" Luo Junyi clutched his chest and spat out several mouthfuls of blood. His face was full of disbelief.
Luo Zheng sneered and scoffed at Luo Junyi's words.
He scanned the Luo family from top to bottom and asked, "Now, who else dares to stop me?"
At this moment, Luo Zheng's aggressiveness and arrogance were clearly visible.
No one dared to answer. The entire Drill Ground was dead silent.
Even Luo Junyi was injured by Luo Zheng's punch. Who else present could be Luo Zheng's opponent?
At this moment, a voice floated out from the corner, "I dare to stop you."
Then, a middle-aged man dressed in white walked out from the corner. This middle-aged man was handsome and had an elegant figure. He was like an immortal who had cultivated to become a sage. His every movement had a graceful bearing.
"Luo Bingquan!"
Seeing this person, Luo Zheng frowned.
If there was one person Luo Zheng didn't want to meet at this moment, it would be his second uncle, Luo Bingquan. He was the mastermind behind his father's murder. His third uncle, Luo Junyi, who was injured by Luo Zheng, could only be considered an accomplice!
As soon as Luo Bingquan appeared, his body emitted an almost tangible aura that swept towards Luo Zheng. As if facing a great enemy, Luo Zheng bowed slightly. Every muscle and bone in his body entered a state of alert!
Luo Bingquan's strength had already surpassed the Marrow Refining stage. Although he hadn't stepped into the Xiantian stage, he already had one foot in it. He was a "half-step into the Xiantian stage" expert!
And Luo Zheng had just stepped into the Viscera Refining stage. There was an entire Marrow Refining stage between him and Luo Bingquan!
To Luo Zheng, this was an existence he couldn't surpass. They weren't on the same level as each other.
But he would never give up!
If he wanted to give up, Luo Zheng would have done so two years ago!
The heavens had taken pity on Luo Zheng and gave him a chance to turn things around. He frantically warned himself that he couldn't die here. At this moment, his desire to live was incomparably strong.
Luo Zheng was silent for a while. He quietly took a big gulp of air. Without any warning, he crazily circulated his strength and strode out with his powerful legs.
But before he could get far, a long sword wrapped in purple aura flew towards Luo Zheng and nailed itself in front of Luo Zheng, blocking his path.
Luo Zheng twisted his waist, trying to avoid the purple long sword. However, another purple long sword blocked his path. Then, purple long swords continuously shot towards Luo Zheng, forcing Luo Zheng to retreat step by step.
Under the pressure of the purple long swords, Luo Zheng actually retreated to his original position. His expression turned ugly. Although Luo Bingquan was only a half-step into the Xiantian stage and couldn't use his True Qi freely, the power was already so terrifying …
Luo Bingquan said with his hands behind his back, "You bastard, I let you live in the Luo Family for the sake of our family. I didn't expect you to not know your place. You even injured your third uncle and tried to leave the Luo Family! Since you want to die, I'll fulfill your wish! "
The purple long swords spun and flew up from the ground, stabbing towards Luo Zheng from different directions. Luo Zheng's eyes were about to pop out of their sockets. He couldn't dodge now. Even if he was as tough as a Profound Weapon, his defense was as fragile as paper in front of a half-step into the Xiantian stage like Luo Bingquan!
Luo Zheng couldn't accept this. Deep unwillingness rose in his heart.
At this moment, Luo Junyi suddenly stopped him and said, "Second Brother, don't kill him first."
Luo Bingquan controlled the purple long swords that were stabbing towards Luo Zheng and asked, "Why?"
"I don't know what kind of fortuitous encounter this kid had. His body is much stronger than ordinary people. Moreover, his cultivation speed is comparable to Pei Ran and Cheng Yun who ate the Fortune of Heaven and Earth Elixir," Luo Junyi explained.
Luo Bingquan aimed a purple long sword at Luo Zheng's forehead and said expressionlessly, "Tell me, what kind of fortuitous encounter did you have?"
Luo Zheng sneered. He would die if he didn't speak, so why waste his breath? He didn't even want to say a single word.
At this moment, the plaque on the Luo family's gate suddenly exploded. A bronze cauldron as tall as a person suddenly fell from the sky and heavily smashed into the ground with a "bang". The sound of the collision made the ears of the Luo family disciples go numb.
After the bronze cauldron smashed into the ground, it rolled down the steps, knocking the disciples of the Luo family all over the place and causing them to scream repeatedly.
"Who's causing trouble?"
Luo Bingquan snorted coldly. However, he controlled the purple long sword to change direction. It floated up and stabbed towards the tumbling bronze cauldron.
"Ding ding ding ding ding ding!"
The purple long sword and the bronze cauldron collided, producing crisp sounds. However, they couldn't stop the cauldron from moving forward.
After the bronze cauldron rolled down the steps, it suddenly turned in a strange circle and unexpectedly rolled towards Luo Zheng. Seeing this, Luo Bingquan cursed. Using his body movement, he hurriedly grabbed at Luo Zheng.
But in the end, the bronze cauldron was still a bit faster. When it approached Luo Zheng, a withered hand suddenly reached out from the cauldron and pulled Luo Zheng into the cauldron.
"You want to leave? No way!" Luo Bingquan saw that Luo Zheng had been taken away by the person in the cauldron. He reached out and grabbed the edge of the cauldron, forcibly fixing the cauldron in place.
In the cauldron, the withered hand turned into a sharp claw and suddenly grabbed at Luo Bingquan.
Luo Bingquan's reaction was also very fast. He backhanded his palm and hit the withered hand. Luo Bingquan immediately retreated a few steps and said with an ugly expression, "Are you Xie Lang?"
As soon as Luo Bingquan's voice fell, an old man crawled out of the cauldron. This old man was extremely thin. There wasn't much flesh on his body. He was as scary as a skeleton.

Chapter 10
Xie Lang was a weapon refiner in Chongyang County.
In the East Region, weapon refiners were a very popular profession. Most families were willing to pay a high price to treat them as guests of honor to forge divine weapons for the family.
However, most families in the East Region hated and hated Xie Lang very much when they mentioned him. They wanted to kill him as soon as possible.
This was because this person's actions were very strange and his weapon refining methods were very evil. Every time he opened the furnace, he would use the blood of living people to refine it. He would even throw living people into the furnace and burn them alive.
Such a vicious person was wanted and surrounded by many families in the East Region. However, this person's strength was tyrannical and his whereabouts were erratic. He was lucky to escape several encirclements.
Unexpectedly, he happened to pass by here today and inexplicably picked Luo Zheng. Moreover, he stretched out his hand to kidnap her without saying a word.
"Xie Lang, this person is from the Luo Family. Let him out quickly," Luo Bingquan said solemnly. Although he was a Half-step to Innate Realm, he would not be relaxed when facing Xie Lang.
Xie Lang clicked his tongue and said with a smile, "Since he is from the Luo Family, why do you still point your sword at him? Since you want to kill him so much, wouldn't it be better if I took care of him for you? "
"Since the unfilial son of my family is to be dealt with by me, the patriarch, those who offend the Luo Family will not have a good ending. Don't make a mistake!" Luo Bingquan said seriously. Those purple long swords floated around him, ready to attack.
"If Luo Xiao was here, I would have some scruples. But you … Haha, you are still lacking. Who in the Luo Family can't be offended by me now?" Xie Lang laughed shrilly.
"Such a demon, spouting nonsense. Watch me kill you here with my own hands!" Luo Bingquan's face darkened. The purple long sword whistled and slashed towards Xie Lang.
"Let's see how you kill me!" With a sharp laugh, Xie Lang drilled back into the copper furnace. The copper furnace started to roll, and actually went back and charged towards the Luo Family disciples.
When the Luo Family's disciples saw the huge cauldron rolling towards them, all of them screamed for their parents and fled in all directions. Some of the Luo Family's disciples couldn't dodge in time and were sent flying to the side. Their bodies were badly mutilated, and it was unknown if they were still alive.
Luo Bingquan followed behind, constantly controlling the purple longsword to slash at the copper furnace. Although his purple longswords were incomparably sharp, the copper furnace had some unknown metal added to it. Under the slashing of the purple longsword, it only produced a series of clanging sounds, but not a single mark was left behind.
The copper cauldron crushed the entire Drill Ground into a mess. The disciples of the Luo Family screamed again and again. Then, it turned around and swaggered away …
Luo Bingquan watched helplessly as the copper cauldron rolled further and further away, but he was powerless to do anything. He gritted his teeth and was just about to raise his sword to chase after it when he was stopped by Luo Junyi. "Second Brother, this demon's actions are strange. It's better not to chase after it."
"That unfilial son, Luo Zheng, how should we deal with him?" Luo Bingquan said expressionlessly.
Luo Junyi sneered and said, "This Xie Lang's actions are vicious. Most of the living people that he captured were thrown into the furnace and burned alive. Luo Zheng definitely won't be able to survive in his hands."
Luo Bingquan nodded and glanced around at the disciples of the Luo Family. There was a surge of uneasiness in his heart, but he couldn't figure out where this uneasiness came from. So, he said to Luo Junyi in annoyance, "Pass down the order. Do your best to treat the injured disciples of the Luo Family today!"
On the Drill Ground, there were probably dozens of injured disciples of the Luo Family. Many of them had broken legs or ribs, and were crying and screaming in pain.
When the other disciples of the Luo Family who were not injured saw this scene, their hearts were gloomy.
Putting aside the grudges between Luo Zheng and Second Uncle and Third Uncle, the Luo Family had indeed declined.
In the past, when Luo Zheng's father, Luo Xiao, was still alive, how could a demon like Xie Lang dare to come to their door so brazenly?
Moreover, the decline of the Luo Family could be seen in many subtle ways.
In the ranking of the big families in Chongyang County, the Luo Family, which had always been at the top, was now ranked outside the top three.
In the past, the disciples of the Luo Family walked on the streets, showing off their prowess. In Chongyang County, who dared to provoke them?
Now, the disciples of the Luo Family had become cowards. They even had to look at the faces of some servants in the family.
These days, they couldn't live anymore …
…
…
Luo Zheng shrank in the small copper furnace and didn't make a sound.
As the former Young Master, Luo Zheng had of course heard of Xie Lang. His father had told him more than once that if Xie Lang fell into his hands, he would use the three feet long Qingfeng Sword in his hand to cut Xie Lang into two.
Luo Zheng had also heard of Xie Lang's various atrocities, such as using living people as sacrificial offerings to refine weapons.
Falling into the hands of this person, Luo Zheng could only sigh and say that he was unlucky. He had just escaped from the wolf's den and landed in the tiger's den.
The copper furnace rolled forward, and Luo Zheng also followed it and kept spinning. In addition, there was a rotten smell coming from Lang Xie's body, which made Luo Zheng almost vomit.
After rolling for a while, the bronze cauldron suddenly stopped. Lang Xie stared at Luo Zheng with his empty eyes, which were as hollow as a skeleton's. He even sniffed Luo Zheng with his nose, then said with a puzzled face, "This is strange. I have never seen a body like yours in all these years. You don't seem to be a human! The smell on your body is very similar to the profound weapons that I have refined. "
"I am a living person with hands and feet. If I am not a human, then what am I? I advise you to let me go. I am of no help to you in refining weapons. "Luo Zheng said snappily, but his heart skipped a beat. This Xie Lang's nose was so sensitive that he could smell the body of a profound weapon.
"Let you go? Hehe, don't count on it. I like people with a special body like yours. If I throw you into my precious refining furnace, I don't know what kind of things I can refine! " After saying this, Xie Lang reached out and handcuffed Luo Zheng with a chain in the copper furnace. Then he jumped out of the copper furnace.
The copper furnace suddenly rose from the ground and floated forward. It turned out that Lang Xie had used his hand to hold the copper furnace and was running wildly. His speed was much faster than before.
This made it convenient for Luo Zheng. Just now, he was rolling forward and it was really uncomfortable. Now, he didn't have to smell the rotten smell of Xie Lang's body. He could even stick his head out of the copper furnace and look at the surrounding scenery.
As for the chain that was handcuffing him, it was neither gold nor iron. He pulled hard and it didn't move an inch. So he gave up the idea of breaking the chain. Even if he could escape from the copper furnace, so what? Xie Lang wasn't even afraid of Luo Bingquan. How could he escape in front of Xie Lang?
Relying on his bare feet, Xie Lang ran at an extremely fast speed. The dense black forest continued to fly behind Luo Zheng. Looking at the towering trees and the ghostly cries of crows and owls, he reckoned that he had reached the deepest part of the forest.
After passing through the large forest, Luo Zheng saw a cliff suddenly appear in front of him. However, Xie Lang didn't seem to know about it. He ran straight to the end of the cliff and finally jumped up with the copper furnace.
If he jumped down from the cliff like this, wouldn't he be smashed to pieces? Luo Zheng firmly grabbed the edge of the copper furnace. Just as he was panicking, the copper furnace stopped falling.
It turned out that on the cliff, there were rocks that looked like barbs protruding out. Xie Lang held the copper furnace with one hand and grabbed the barbs with the other. Just like that, he descended down the cliff step by step.
At the end of the cliff, there was a towering tree with dense branches and leaves. Xie Lang stepped on the trunk of the big tree and stretched out his hand to push aside the dense branches and leaves, revealing a big hole.
The hole was narrow and the copper furnace could barely squeeze in. However, the deeper he went in, the more space there was. It was a completely different world inside.
"It's no wonder that Xie Lang managed to escape even after Chongyang County launched several joint manhunts. He actually placed his lair in such a place. It's too secretive," Luo Zheng thought to himself.
The interior of the cave was dozens of feet high. The walls of the cave flickered with a dark red light. Looking carefully, there was a faint flow of underground fire. This place was an excellent place for refining weapons.
In the middle of the interior, there was a black refining furnace. The furnace had four legs and was completely black. Eight sharp thorns protruded out of the furnace's walls. The end of each of the sharp thorns actually pierced into a person's body!
This person's blood essence had been completely absorbed by the sharp thorns. All of them were skinny and were even scarier than skeletons. However, their abdomens were undulating and they were on the verge of death. They were actually not dead yet. These were all living people!
Not far from the crafting furnace, there were a dozen or so iron cages made of refined iron. Each of the cages was about a meter long, and each of them had a living person curled up inside. Most of these people had lifeless eyes, and their bodies were constantly trembling.
It was said that Xie Lang's methods were cruel and vicious. Now, it seemed that it was true. He actually used such an evil method to refine weapons. Seeing this scene, Luo Zheng was secretly shocked.
"Clang!"
The copper furnace was thrown heavily onto the ground. Xie Lang laughed shrilly and climbed onto the copper furnace. He extended his nose in front of Luo Zheng and sniffed. A satisfied smile appeared on his face as he said, "Using flesh to refine weapons and sealing a person's resentment into the weapon. The Profound Weapon refined in this way will naturally have a strong resentment and its power will increase greatly! I don't know why, but the aura of your flesh and blood is very similar to that of the Profound Weapon. If I refine you together with the Profound Weapon, I'm afraid it will increase the power of my 'Hellfire Sword'. Who knows, I might even be able to refine it into a Spiritual Weapon! "

Chapter 11
Xie Lang was a Profound Rank Weapon Refiner. Relying on these incomparably sinister refining methods, he was most proud of refining three high-grade Profound Armaments in his life. That 'Hellfire Sword' was also one of the three high-grade Profound Armaments.
But Xie Lang was not satisfied with refining Profound Armaments. His biggest dream in life was to be able to refine a Spiritual Weapon!
In the current world, as long as it was a graded weapon, it was priceless.
Just like the Luo Clan, they only had one Upper Grade Profound Armament. That Upper Grade Profound Armament was Luo Zheng's father, Luo Xiao's sword, "Green Glow Wind Chasing Sword". This Upper Grade Profound Armament was the only one in Chong Yang County. Luo Xiao rarely used it and hid it in the most secretive place in the clan. After Luo Bingquan harmed Luo Xiao, he had dug three feet into the ground to find this sword but to no avail. Until now, no one knew where the Green Glow Wind Chasing Sword was hidden.
And this was only a Upper Grade Profound Armament.
If it was a Spiritual Weapon, then it would be even worse. If an ordinary person were to obtain a Spiritual Weapon, they would only be looking for disaster. An ordinary man's wealth would arouse the envy of others. Not to mention an ordinary person, even if the Luo Clan obtained a Spiritual Weapon, they would have to obediently hand it over to prevent the clan from being exterminated!
That Spiritual Weapon could be said to be the most valuable treasure in the world. It had all kinds of special abilities. Some could increase the speed of cultivation, some could increase the battle power of the person holding the Spiritual Weapon by several times …
Hearing Xie Lang's words, a bitter smile appeared on Luo Zheng's face. He said, "It's said that the most important thing in the path of refining is the materials and the heat. These two things are not complete, so it's impossible to refine the most perfect treasure. Do you expect my body of flesh and blood to be able to help you refine a spiritual weapon? Isn't this too much of a joke … "
Luo Zheng had read a lot of books. No matter if it was refining pills or refining weapons, he had dabbled in them. But his ambition was in martial arts. He did not delve deeply into these books and only knew a little.
Now that he was in a desperate situation, he could not just sit and wait for death. He tried to persuade Xie Lang to let him go.
"From what you've said, it seems that you've only scratched the surface of the art of refining!" As Xie Lang spoke, he unlocked Luo Zheng's handcuffs and pulled him out of the copper furnace. However, he threw him into a cage at the side and locked the cage with a "clang". A terrifying smile appeared on his skeletal face: "I, Xie Lang, am not strong enough. The rare materials are too far away from me. The True Fire that I use to refine weapons is only of the second grade. If I want to refine spirit weapons, I need to refine them. Of course, I can only use evil methods. As for whether you can be refined into a spiritual artifact after I throw you into the furnace, hehe, that will depend on the fortune of the primordial world! "
But with the Primordial Chaos …
This was something that all the artificers in the world would say.
Refining with True Fire depended ninety percent on strength and one percent on luck.
From the sound of it, luck was actually not that important.
However, there were some craftsmen who, with their heaven-defying luck, managed to craft some supreme-grade supreme treasures.
There were people who spent their entire lives researching and trying to find the pattern, but in the end, they found nothing. In the end, they could only attribute it to luck.
From this point of view, luck seemed unimportant, but at the same time, it was the most important factor.
And Primordial Chaos was the God of Tools in the hearts of the craftsmen. It was the belief of all the craftsmen. Therefore, when they were refining, they would say, "Let's rely on the fortune of the primordial world."
This sentence was similar to the "Pray to the Heavens" of those religious people.
Thinking that his life was just a gamble of luck for Xie Lang, Luo Zheng could only smile bitterly and feel deeply unreconciled.
He could only blame himself for being too weak.
In this one month, he had advanced rapidly. In one month, he had advanced from the Flesh Refinement Stage to the Organs Refinement Stage.
However, compared to people like Xie Lang and Luo Bingquan, the gap was still too big.
It was not easy to have hope, but he had fallen into such a desperate situation. Luo Zheng could only sigh at the unfairness of fate.
Xie Lang was busy in the cave for a long time. First, he knocked in the corner, then he carried an object into the crafting furnace. After coming out, he sat in front of the crafting furnace, then clapped his hands and made a strange posture.
At the same time, the black-colored crafting furnace suddenly lit up. A series of complicated but neat runes blossomed on the walls of the furnace. For a moment, it emitted an intense red light, illuminating the entire cave.
The living people who were pierced by the spikes extended from the crafting furnace all had hunched backs. Their mouths were constantly emitting "Hehe" screams. Their expressions were extremely painful. Drops of blood flowed along the spikes into the crafting furnace. The crafting furnace was actually sucking the blood essence of those living people.
The blood essence flowed along the lines on the walls of the crafting furnace. The red light it emitted was even brighter and more alluring. It was incomparably enchanting.
After activating the crafting furnace, a black and white long sword appeared in Xie Lang's hand. This should be the high-grade profound weapon that Xie Lang had mentioned, the Hellfire Sword.
Xie Lang held the Hellfire Sword in his hand and stroked it for a while. His gaze seemed to be much gentler, as if he was looking at his own son. From the face of such a demon, Luo Zheng, who was secretly observing from the side, blushed with shame. This person was completely a madman.
After stroking it for a while, Xie Lang turned his head and smiled strangely at Luo Zheng. He walked over and pulled Luo Zheng out of the cage and said, "You should feel honored to be able to fuse with my Hellfire Sword!"
Luo Zheng shook his head. It was futile to communicate with such a madman. Unfortunately, this madman's strength was so high. He could only admit that he was unlucky. It was a pity that before he could take revenge, he was about to be burned to ashes by Xie Lang. He could only resent the heavens for not opening their eyes.
Being dragged by Xie Lang all the way to the crafting furnace, Luo Zheng was pushed in.
The crafting furnace was dark and there were traces of being burned by the fire everywhere. In the center of the furnace, there was a table.
Then Xie Lang also came in and placed his Hellfire Sword on the table. He laughed sharply at Luo Zheng and was about to come out of the crafting furnace.
Just as Xie Lang walked to the mouth of the crafting furnace, he suddenly turned his head. With a flick of his finger, a yellow powder flew towards Luo Zheng.
The smell of the yellow powder was fragrant, but after inhaling a little, Luo Zheng immediately felt his hands and feet go soft. This powder was actually the Ten Fragrant Tendon Weakening Powder. This kind of knockout drug could paralyze the meridians in a short period of time, causing the hands and feet to be weak.
Luo Zheng originally planned to snatch the Hellfire Sword and smash the crafting furnace to fight with Xie Lang. It was better than being burned to ashes here. Now, he had completely given up on this idea. As soon as he used his strength, he felt his whole body go soft and he couldn't muster up the slightest bit of strength.
Am I, Luo Zheng's life going to end here?
I am a fish on the chopping block. If you want to blame someone, blame it on my weak strength! I can only be trampled on.
He clenched his teeth and his face revealed a look of despair. While his mind was wandering, he saw a flame suddenly rush in from the center of the crafting furnace.
The flames were bright yellow in color. As the flames burned, they looked like yellow lotuses. These flames should be Xie Lang's Natal True Fire.
As soon as the True Life Fire appeared, it immediately spread out and filled the entire crafting furnace. Luo Zheng also felt a wave of boiling heat in front of him. He was already enveloped by the True Life Fire.
"Puff!"
Luo Zheng's clothes were almost instantly ignited by the flame and turned into ashes.
When the True Life Fire touched his skin, he suddenly felt a burning sensation. It was the True Life Fire burning his skin. Luo Zheng clenched his teeth and prepared to welcome the pain brought by the burning. But after clenching his teeth for a long time, the pain that he imagined didn't come.
He only felt a little burning. This burning sensation, other than making him feel a little uncomfortable, didn't cause too much discomfort.
Luo Zheng opened his closed eyes in puzzlement and looked down at his body. Other than his clothes being burned, his body didn't have the slightest injury. Not only was his skin not burned, even his hair was not burned.
Could it be that he wasn't afraid of the True Life Fire at all?
Luo Zheng, who originally thought that he was going to die, suddenly felt a burst of ecstasy.
Although he didn't know what was going on, the inconceivable scene in front of him must be related to what happened in the cellar that day. Could it be that after he became a Profound Weapon, he wasn't afraid of being burned by the True Life Fire at all?
Just as he was thinking this, the True Life Fire pouring in from the outside of the crafting furnace increased in intensity.
Wisps of yellow True Life Fire that was shaped like a lotus turned into two invisible hands and continuously attacked Luo Zheng's body and the "Hellfire Sword" that was placed on the table. After the intensity of the fire increased, although Luo Zheng felt that the burning sensation had increased, it was still within the range that he could endure.
In contrast, the Hellfire Sword had undergone a change. Whether it was the sword blade or the sword hilt, they all turned red. The black and white runes on the sword also began to flicker with a strange light, as if they were absorbing the energy from the yellow True Life Fire.
"So when a Weapon Refiner refines a weapon, he controls the tempering process of the True Life Fire. After burning the weapon until it is completely red, he then injects the energy from the True Life Fire into it. But this method is very unique. This True Life Fire is neither close nor distant around the Hellfire Sword, and it's suspended in the air …" Unintentionally, Luo Zheng watched the process of a Weapon Refiner refining a weapon, and it was in the crafting furnace.
Luo Zheng watched the process of refining with relish. Suddenly, someone outside the crafting furnace exclaimed. It was Xie Lang who discovered Luo Zheng's strangeness.
Xie Lang, who was outside the crafting furnace, did not expect that his True Life Fire had been burning for quite a while. Even the Hellfire Sword had been burned red by him, yet this young man was still alive?
Although this young man's body did indeed emit the aura of a Profound Weapon, that being said, he still had a physical body after all! Could it be that this young man's body was really comparable to a Xuan Artifact?
Thinking of this, his haggard face was filled with excitement. He, Xie Lang, did not take the orthodox path of refining weapons, so the more bizarre and strange the materials were, the more he liked them.
Just like the Hellfire Sword that he had refined, it was refined using two materials that conflicted with Yin and Yang. If it was any other Weapon Refiner, they would definitely not fuse these two materials together to refine. However, Xie Lang did not believe in this evil. Not only did he refine it, he even refined a high-grade Xuan Artifact.
This was relying on the Primordial Chaos!
Now that he saw Luo Zheng's strange physique, although his True Life Fire was only second-grade, it was ten times more powerful than ordinary flames. How could Xie Lang not be surprised when he saw that it could not burn the young man to death?
Seeing that this young man was actually unharmed under the refinement of his True Life Fire, on one hand, he was pleasantly surprised. On the other hand, he was somewhat depressed. Even though this young man's body was a heavenly treasure, what was the use if his True Life Fire could not burn it?
After thinking for a while, he reached out and took out a pill from his bosom. The pill was greenish-gray in color and there were lines of flame-like pill patterns on the surface of the pill.
"Fire Melting Pill!"
This third-grade pill was priceless. It could forcefully raise one's Natal True Life Fire by a level in a short period of time. Back then, in order to obtain this pill, he had to use a high-grade Xuan Artifact to exchange for it.
This Fire Melting Pill had been with him for many years. As it was too precious, he had always been reluctant to use it.
Today, when he took out this Fire Melting Pill, his eyes revealed a hint of hesitation. If he added this Fire Melting Pill, it would be considered a huge gamble. Xie Lang thought about it again. How many times had he refined high-grade Xuan Artifacts? Which one of them was not a huge gamble? If he gambled correctly this time, he would be able to raise the quality of his Hellfire Sword to a Spiritual Weapon …
Thinking of this, Xie Lang's heart burned with passion. He swallowed the Fire Melting Pill in one gulp.
This Fire Melting Pill was a pill of extreme Yang. The moment he swallowed it, Xie Lang felt as if his throat was being burned by fire. He could even spit out fire from his seven orifices. With a loud roar, he circulated the True Life Fire in his body and crazily poured it into the crafting furnace.

Chapter 12
The original bright yellow lotus flames had now turned into a demonic golden red. Each lotus flame was emitting a terrifying heat.
When these golden red lotus flames rushed towards Luo Zheng, his complexion changed. The power of this Lotus True Fire had suddenly increased by several times. His body might not be able to withstand it.
Just as Luo Zheng expected, this golden red lotus flame was far more powerful than the previous bright yellow lotus flame.
When that golden red flame touched Luo Zheng's skin, an intense burning pain came from his body. Luo Zheng endured the pain and strangely found that his body had turned dark red. It was exactly the same as what had happened in the cellar that day.
When ordinary people were burned by high temperature, the moisture in their body would first be dried up. Finally, they would be ignited and turned into a pile of charcoal.
But Luo Zheng's body was so strange. It was really like a profound weapon made of fine iron. It was actually slowly burning red.
Those tiny golden leaves that were originally buried in his skin were now floating on Luo Zheng's skin. For a moment, his whole body was covered by those glittering golden leaves. For a moment, the golden light was shining brightly.
The obscure tadpole-like characters on those tiny golden leaves began to spin. The spinning speed was getting faster and faster. Unexpectedly, tiny vortexes were formed on the surface of Luo Zheng's body.
After these vortexes were formed, they produced a fierce suction force. The lotus flames in the entire crafting furnace rushed towards Luo Zheng's body and were sucked into those tiny vortexes.
True Fire refining the body!
His body was actually forcibly sucking in all the True Fire.
Those lotus flames endlessly drilled into Luo Zheng's body. His arms, his body, his legs, his neck … …
This process was extremely painful. This pain was not only physical. The lotus flames even penetrated his skin and burned every inch of his body.
He clenched his teeth and endured this pain.
Compared to the pain of his soul being refined by the black flames, the pain of his body was much lighter.
Under the burning of the True Fire, Luo Zheng felt that the poison of the Ten Fragrant Tendon Weakening Powder in his body was slowly disappearing!
At the same time, Luo Zheng felt that the huge furnace that had been quietly floating in his mind was about to move. The abnormally calm black flames in the furnace were now like a wild horse that had escaped its reins. They shot out of the furnace and finally penetrated Luo Zheng's consciousness and drilled out from between Luo Zheng's eyebrows!
This black flame seemed to have a life of its own. It appeared in front of Luo Zheng.
And as soon as it appeared, it let out a strange cry and pounced towards the Karma Fire Sword.
The Karmic Fire Sword had been burned by Xie Lang's True Fire for so long, but it had only turned red. However, with just a light touch of the black flame, the priceless Karmic Fire Sword, which was known as a high-grade Xuan Artifact, instantly melted into a few drops of molten iron.
Seeing the power of the black flame, Luo Zheng was flabbergasted. What was the origin of this black flame? How could it be so terrifying?
The black flame wrapped around the molten iron of the Karma Fire Sword and drilled into between Luo Zheng's eyebrows, returning to Luo Zheng's mind. Originally, Luo Zheng was terrified. Although he had a Xuan Weapon body, he couldn't possibly refine the molten iron into his head, right?
However, Luo Zheng didn't feel any discomfort. In Luo Zheng's mind, the black flame wrapped around the few drops of molten iron and sent them into the mouth of the Qinglong relief sculpture.
There were nine huge dragon reliefs on the huge furnace. Only the Qinglong's eyes were open. At this moment, the Qinglong let out a low dragon roar. It raised its head and swallowed the few drops of molten iron. Qinglong's body originally had tens of thousands of dull scales. However, after the Qinglong swallowed the few drops of molten iron, a strange change occurred.
At the tail of the Qinglong, there was a scale that was emitting a cyan brilliance. It was like a flawless emerald, very beautiful.
The few drops of molten iron of the Karma Fire Sword had activated a scale on the Qinglong relief sculpture!
This scene that occurred in his mind made Luo Zheng incomparably astonished.
At the same time, he felt a surge of power gushing out from the scale, pouring into his body like a torrent.
His strength was actually increasing at a rapid pace!
Could it be that the scales on the dragon's body could be activated as long as the black flame kept devouring Xuan Weapons?
So that's how it was, that's how it was! Luo Zheng's face revealed a look of ecstasy. After being sacrificially refined in the crafting furnace, he seemed to understand something about the huge furnace.
Just a single scale had increased his strength by several times. What would happen if he lit up all the tens of thousands of scales on the Azure Dragon's body? Moreover, there were white dragons, purple dragons, black dragons, and blue dragons on the Qinglong relief sculpture …
How terrifying would his power be if he activated all the scales on the nine dragons?
Tsk, tsk. Luo Zheng licked his dry lips. That terrifying power was beyond his imagination.
However, it seemed that it would not be easy to light up the dragon scales.
According to Xie Lang, the Karma Fire Sword was an Upper Grade Xuan Weapon. It was priceless!
The essence of a Upper Grade Xuan Weapon could only light up one scale. How many treasures would it take to light up tens of thousands of scales? Even if all the treasures in the Eastern Region were used to smelt, it would still be difficult to light up all the scales on the Qinglong, not to mention that there were eight other dragons above the Qinglong.
This matter needed to be considered at length. He could not be impatient!
Luo Zheng was not arrogant and impatient. He sat down cross-legged in the blazing Genuine Fire and let the golden vortex on his body absorb the lotus flame, using the fire to refine his body.
Xie Lang, who was outside the crafting furnace, also discovered the strange matter. His face revealed a trace of doubt. From the beginning, he could not feel the existence of his Karma Fire Sword. Could it be that it had fused with that brat? At the same time, he could not feel the brat's life force.
Moreover, he discovered that the Genuine Life Fire that he had released was continuously disappearing. What strange thing was happening in the crafting furnace?
Maybe he had succeeded in refining the Spiritual Weapon! This was also very possible!
As long as one was a crafting master, it was clear that when the crafting process was about to end and a treasure was about to be produced, it would absorb a large amount of Genuine Life Fire. This stage was called "Condensation".
According to the grade of the treasure, the amount of Genuine Life Fire that needed to be condensed was not the same. The higher the grade of the treasure, the more Genuine Life Fire that needed to be condensed.
When Xie Lang was refining the "Karma Fire Sword", he had to absorb a full two hours of Genuine Life Fire during the condensation stage before it could be produced.
However, it had already far exceeded the time of three incense sticks …
The higher the grade of the treasure, the more Genuine Life Fire it would absorb during the condensation process, and the longer it would take. The treasure in the crafting furnace had absorbed so much Genuine Life Fire for so long. It was extremely likely that it was a Spiritual Weapon!
Thinking of this, Xie Lang's heart immediately burned with passion.
Indeed, only a Spiritual Weapon could absorb so much Genuine Life Fire during the condensation process.
Without saying a word, he went all out and continuously activated the Genuine Life Fire in his body, sending it into the crafting furnace.
Although Xie Lang had sent in a lot of Genuine Life Fire, it was as if there was a small black hole inside the crafting furnace.
Six hours later, Xie Lang was already drenched in sweat and panting heavily.
After all, Xie Lang was only a "Half-step Innate". With his identity as a craftsman, his control of Genuine Life Fire had already far surpassed that of others of the same level. However, he had not stepped into the Precelestial Realm, so releasing so much Genuine Life Fire at once was an extremely strenuous task for him.
However, he was worried. As a craftsman, he was very clear about the importance of the "Condensation" process. If the "Condensation" process was not done well, the weapon in the crafting furnace would probably be wasted!
Xie Lang had no other choice but to grit his teeth and endure.
Until twenty hours later …
Xie Lang squeezed out the last bit of Genuine Life Fire in his body, and with a "plop" sound, he laid on the ground, panting heavily. He could no longer hold on.
After resting for a while, Xie Lang crawled up from the ground and took out a few black pills from his bosom to swallow them. After replenishing his strength, he walked towards the crafting furnace.
The moment he opened the crafting furnace, Xie Lang's expression was very complicated. He was not sure if the spirit weapon had been successfully refined.

Chapter 13
After all, Xie Lang was a half-step Xiantian expert. His reaction was extremely fast. Facing this heavy punch, he stomped on the ground and his entire body flew out.
However, Luo Zheng's punch was extremely fast. It still hit Xie Lang's body. Although Xie Lang used his retreating action to reduce half of the force, the normal force still caused Xie Lang's blood to churn. After landing, Xie Lang spat out a mouthful of blood. At the same time, he said with a complicated expression, "You're actually not dead yet!"
"Thanks to you, I'm not dead yet!" Luo Zheng said as he clenched his fist. He was secretly shocked in his heart. He had already stepped into the Viscera Refinement stage, and his strength had already reached three cauldrons of strength. Relying on the dragon scale on the Azure Dragon relief sculpture, his strength had more than doubled. In the punch just now, he had mobilized all the strength in his body. He wanted to take advantage of Xie Lang's unpreparedness and kill him in one blow.
He didn't expect Xie Lang's reaction to be so fast. He had almost dodged his extremely threatening punch in an instant.
Compared to Luo Zheng, Xie Lang was even more shocked. This brat was merely in the Viscera Refining Realm. This kind of strength was not worth mentioning at all. However, after throwing this brat into the crafting furnace and refining it, how did his strength suddenly increase?
If he hadn't dodged that punch quickly, he would have been killed by this brat's punch.
"Where's my Karmic Fire Sword?" Xie Lang asked. In comparison, he was most concerned about his own treasure.
Luo Zheng smiled and spread his hands towards Xie Lang. He revealed two rows of white teeth and said, "Of course it was eaten by me!"
"Eaten by you?" Xie Lang's face revealed an expression of disbelief. The hardness of a high-grade profound weapon was extremely high. How could it be eaten by someone? However, looking at this brat's naked body, there was no place to hide the Karmic Fire Sword. The crafting furnace was also empty. Where was the shadow of his Karmic Fire Sword?
Xie Lang's face was filled with rage as he shouted sternly, "Where did my Karmic Fire Sword go?"
"I already said that I ate it …" Luo Zheng felt that he was telling the truth. The Karmic Fire Sword had been refined into molten iron essence by the black flames and was swallowed by the Qinglong in his mind. It could indeed be said that he had "eaten" it.
"Alright, since you said you ate it, I'll cut open your stomach and see if it's in your stomach!" As soon as his voice fell, Xie Lang's figure instantly exploded. His pair of withered branch-like hands grabbed towards Luo Zheng's chest. He actually wanted to forcefully rip open Luo Zheng's stomach.
How could Luo Zheng allow Xie Lang to touch him so easily? After going through the tempering of the True Fire, the strength of his body had increased once again. Now, his body was comparable to a mid-grade Profound Artifact. He moved his feet lightly, and with the use of his strength, the bones in his entire body exploded, reverberating throughout the cave. It was as if there were bursts of thunder, deafening the ears.
"Red Sandalwood Inch Punch!"
In a head-on clash, Luo Zheng was not weak at all. In terms of physical strength, Luo Zheng was a Xuan Weapon. After being calcined by the Real Fire, his body was comparable to a middle-grade Xuan Weapon. In terms of strength, although he was only at the Viscera Refining stage, with the help of the awakened power of the dragon scale, he wouldn't lose out to even a half-step Xiantian expert!
What's more, Xie Lang had used his True Fire to calcine him for twenty hours. It was close to a day and a night. The strength in his entire body was already exhausted. He was like an arrow at the end of its flight.
Just as the two of them were about to clash, Xie Lang's figure tilted. He actually drew an arc in the air at an extremely fast speed, and chopped with his hand!
"Roaring Flame Blade!"
"Ping!"
The strength of a half-step Xiantian expert was astonishing. Moreover, Xie Lang's attack was mixed with the burning power of his True Fire. This hand chop actually split open a crack on Luo Zheng's skin.
Luo Zheng and Xie Lang were both extremely shocked!
Xie Lang was shocked that Luo Zheng's body was actually so hard. In Xie Lang's memory, even the bodies of those special races in the Savage Lands couldn't be so hard. His Roaring Flame Blade contained the power of his True Fire. Even if it was reinforced steel and iron bones, it could split open with one chop.
However, when the attack just now cut open Luo Zheng's skin and touched his bones, it actually made a sound of metal clashing. What was going on? Could it be that this brat's body itself was a Xuan Tool?
Luo Zheng was shocked that Xie Lang could still be so fast in this kind of situation. He couldn't catch Xie Lang's figure at all.
"Hmph, so what if your body is hard? After all, you are only in the Viscera Refining Realm. Today, you are destined to die here. I will refine your body and make up for my loss!" As soon as Xie Lang finished speaking, he rushed towards Luo Zheng with a series of afterimages.
"Bang!" a sound was heard.
Another wound appeared on Luo Zheng's body and blood flowed out.
"Clang!"
"Bang!"
Every time Xie Lang charged at Luo Zheng, a terrifying wound would appear on his body.
The situation was very unfavorable for Luo Zheng. Although his body's strength was terrifying now, Xie Lang relied on his speed advantage to continuously attack him. He had no chance of winning. He would be exhausted to death by Xie Lang.
In this kind of situation, he could only take the risk!
Luo Zheng suddenly closed his eyes. His hands hung down. It seemed that he had completely given up on resisting.
Since he couldn't catch Xie Lang, no matter how hard he tried, it would be useless.
"You gave up just like that?" Xie Lang was also a person who had experienced hundreds of battles. Seeing Luo Zheng like this, he didn't let down his guard. Instead, he attacked Luo Zheng with his Roaring Flame Blade at an extremely high speed. Two more wounds appeared on Luo Zheng's body.
"Hehe, let's see how long you can endure!"
Xie Lang laughed shrilly and rushed towards Luo Zheng again. This time, it seemed that he wanted to cut Luo Zheng with his blade again. However, the moment he got close to Luo Zheng, he circled to the back of Luo Zheng's head. His hands lit up with lotus flames.
Xie Lang let out a shrill laugh as he charged towards Luo Zheng's head. He actually wanted to pull Luo Zheng's head out of his body.
"He's coming!"
At the critical moment, Luo Zheng suddenly opened his eyes. He had been waiting for this opportunity. Suddenly, he used his arms to protect his head.
Just when Xie Lang's hands touched Luo Zheng's arms, Luo Zheng twisted his hands and firmly held Xie Lang's skinny arms. Then, he shouted, "Get down!"
"Bang!"
Under the impact of the huge force, Luo Zheng pressed Xie Lang to the ground. The ground of the cave was made of hard stone walls. However, it couldn't withstand this force. The ground was torn apart and a big pit was formed.
Xie Lang was still struggling desperately. He wanted to climb out of the big pit. However, Luo Zheng didn't give Xie Lang a chance at all. Xie Lang's speed was too fast. If he was allowed to climb out, Luo Zheng might not be able to catch him. There was only one chance!
Luo Zheng was like a crazy beast. He punched again and again. Each punch had the strength of a few thousand pounds. He smashed the pit with all his might. After dozens of punches, he finally stopped.
He breathed heavily and looked at Xie Lang lying in the pit among the rocks. He didn't make any more sound.
With the strength of the Viscera Refining Realm, it was still difficult to deal with a Half-step Innate Realm.
