Even if the Blue Cloud Sect's rules were strict, the law could not punish the majority. If Tian Yi was beaten to death, it would be a wrongful death.
Who would have thought that after Tian Yi won three rounds in a row, he would become more and more arrogant. Xiao Yufeng's outer sect disciples heard his words and immediately cursed.

I think it's better for you to be removed from the 33 peaks! "
Hearing Tian Yi's words, Luo Zheng frowned. Xiao Yufeng's outer sect disciples cursed even louder. It seemed that the situation was about to get out of control.
At this moment, Zhang Wuxian, who had been smiling and not speaking, suddenly waved his hand.
His face, which had always been smiling, was now incomparably serious. There was not the slightest trace of a smile on his face. This kind of calm expression appearing on a fatty's face was a very strange thing.
Zhang Wuxian's move suddenly stunned the whole scene.
After all, Zhang Wuxian was ranked seventh among the outer sect disciples.
Zhang Wuxian was very easy to get along with and did not put on airs. He had not offended anyone in Xiao Yufeng.
Such a person's sense of existence was generally very low.

Some of the more experienced outer sect disciples still remembered that when Zhang Wuxian first entered Xiao Yufeng's outer sect, some people felt that Zhang Wuxian was weak and easy to bully. They all went to find trouble with him. In the end, they were easily defeated by Zhang Wuxian.
Only then did everyone understand that this seemingly harmless fatty was definitely a ruthless character.
Zhang Wuxian's strength was stable and deep. He was ranked seventh.
But many people guessed that Zhang Wuxian was definitely hiding his strength. If Zhang Wuxian worked a little harder, it would not be much of a problem for him to enter Xiao Yufeng's outer sect top five.

This was also because Zhang Wuxian's temper was good. If it was someone else standing in front of Tian Yi, they would probably be cursing and beating him. How could they be as tactful as Zhang Wuxian? In reality, those who knew Zhang Wuxian already understood that Zhang Wuxian was actually very angry. "Divine Wood Spike!"
"Bang bang!"

After all, Tian Yi was only half a step into the Xiantian realm. The "Divine Wood Spike" formed by Zhen Qi still had some shadows and was not completely real. If Tian Yi was a Xiantian lifeform, then what rose from the ground at this moment should be pieces of real "Divine Wood".

Chapter 66
Everyone's impression of the fatty was that his reactions were slow and his movements were slow.
But at this moment, Zhang Wuxian broke everyone's impression.
Zhang Wuxian's fat body was like a ghost, shuttling back and forth on the arena, nimbly avoiding Tian Yi's "Divine Wood Spikes."
Every time a Divine Wood Spike appeared under Zhang Wuxian's feet, Zhang Wuxian would move to the side in an instant.
Tian Yi violently struck the ground more than ten times in a row, and more than ten Divine Wood Spikes continuously shot out from the ground, but not a single Divine Wood Spike hit its mark.

Luo Zheng nodded.
Tian Yi's cultivation method was indeed good. If one were to make a comparison, Tian Yi's attacking method was a bit similar to He Tiancheng's. They both poured their True Qi into the ground and launched a surprise attack from the ground. Of course, He Tiancheng's strength was definitely a hundred times stronger than Tian Yi's.
This kind of surprise attack was indeed effective.
However, the biggest taboo for a martial artist when facing an enemy was to dominate the world with one move.
Because once your move was seen through by the opponent, you would be in a very passive position.
Tian Yi had used this move in three consecutive arena matches. Many of Xiao Yufeng's outer sect disciples had also seen it and naturally pondered over a way to counter it.
Luo Zheng noticed that there was a faint layer of yellow light flickering under Zhang Wuxian's feet. He quickly understood how to restrain it.
There were several ways to break the Divine Wood Spike. If Luo Zheng and Zhang Wuxian were in each other's shoes, he could rely on his brute force and tyrannical body to directly crush the Divine Wood Spike.
However, Zhang Wuxian obviously used a more flexible method. He poured his own Zhen Qi into the ground beneath his feet. As long as the Zhen Qi beneath his feet changed in the slightest, he would quickly move to the side. In this way, as long as Tian Yi slapped the ground, Zhang Wuxian would be able to sense the direction of Tian Yi's attack, and naturally be able to easily avoid it.
When Tian Yi saw that the fatty was so agile and that his attack was completely ineffective, he panicked. His arrogance from before was swept away.
"Die for me!" Tian Yi clapped his hands and pointed at Zhang Wuxian. "Divine Wood Spike!"
More than ten brown Zhen Qi vortexes formed around Tian Yi's body. As soon as those Zhen Qi vortexes appeared, Divine Wood Spikes emerged from them and fiercely stabbed at Zhang Wuxian.
"Pssst pssst pssst pssst …"
Divine Wood Spikes were constantly produced. Not only did they emerge from the arena's ground, but many of them also shot at Zhang Wuxian from the air.
However, Zhang Wuxian's body was like a butterfly fluttering in a storm. He dodged left and right, completely avoiding those Divine Wood Spikes.
"It's useless, it's useless. I've already seen through your crappy move," Zhang Wuxian said with a smile as he dodged.
After avoiding the last Divine Wood Spike, Zhang Wuxian's speed suddenly increased. He rushed in front of Tian Yi and smashed his chubby fist directly into Tian Yi's face.
At this moment, Zhang Wu Xian's chubby fists were bursting with immense power.

Zhang Wuxian practiced a relatively special cultivation method. The vital energy produced seemed to be able to greatly increase Zhang Wuxian's speed and reaction ability.
In Luo Zheng's opinion, when Zhang Wuxian was fighting against Tian Yi, he should have held back. Now that he was facing the short man, he was going all out. His speed was greatly increased, and as he moved, he left behind a trail of afterimages behind his fat body.

The short man's speed was actually much faster than Zhang Wuxian's!
Fighting speed with speed!
On the arena, a short figure and a fat figure were constantly intertwining and rushing forward.
This kind of fighting rhythm was so fast that it made the spectators breathless!
Some of the weaker ones, such as Mo Can, who was an outer disciple of the Bone Refining Stage, were already dazzled. They could not see the situation on the arena clearly, so naturally, they did not know who had the upper hand.
Luo Zheng stared at the arena with a deep frown on his face.
The situation was very unfavorable for Zhang Wuxian.
Although the short man was also a half-step Xiantian, his strength was strong. Whether it was his speed or strength, he was much better than Zhang Wuxian.
If this continued, Zhang Wuxian might be defeated.
"Bang!"
"Puff!"

This kind of speed competition did not last long.

"After Zhang Wuxian cursed, he noticed that the person holding him was Luo Zheng. Only then did he react and his face lit up with joy." Hey, Luo Zheng! In this kind of challenge between mountain peaks, under normal circumstances, each side would send out five people to participate in the competition.
For this challenge, Xiao Yufeng had already sent out four people, and all of them had been defeated. Therefore, Xiao Yufeng only had one last chance.

Hao Shige was Xiao Yufeng's number one outer disciple. He was also the strongest outer disciple.
It was said that Hao Shige was breaking through to the Xiantian stage, so he was in seclusion. Naturally, he couldn't come out to fight.

Who else?

I, Luo Zheng, have already killed one. Who else is next?
Compared to Tian Yi and the short man's mocking words, this sentence was much more powerful!

A person from Vulture Peak walked out. That person was tall and sturdy. His muscles were tight and firm, and his white robe was tightly stretched.

"Pop, pop, pop, pop!"

Vulture Peak's foundation was indeed much stronger than Xiao Yufeng's.

As the saying goes, one strong person can defeat ten skilled people. Hu Tie's attack didn't have any fancy moves or feints. He wanted to rely on pure strength to crush Luo Zheng.

Chapter 68
"Get out of the way, get out of the way! If you get hit by this beast-like guy, I'm afraid all the bones in your body will be broken! "

"Alas, Luo Zheng has such strength in the Marrow Refining Realm. He has a bright future ahead of him, but this time he's in a bit of a rush. If he is crippled by Hu Tie, I'm afraid such an enchanting person will die prematurely!"
The strength of the outer sect disciples on Xiao Yufeng's platform is not good, but there is no lack of knowledgeable disciples. They know very well what kind of glory a disciple with such strength in the Marrow Refining Realm will have in the future. Because of this, they feel even more sorry for Luo Zheng.
Facing Hu Tie's attack, Luo Zheng still stubbornly sticks out his fist.
It's still a punch.
Seven dragon scales erupt with a terrifying power. Using the body of a Spirit Tool, Luo Zheng's punch hits Hu Tie's sturdiest part: the shoulder.
Hu Tie originally planned to use his shoulder to hit Luo Zheng. When Luo Zheng sticks out his fist, Hu Tie doesn't dodge, but directly hits the fist.
Hu Tie estimates that if this fist hits his shoulder, Luo Zheng's arm will probably break inch by inch.
But when Hu Tie's shoulder hits Luo Zheng's fist, his face suddenly changes color.
From Luo Zheng's fist comes a power even greater than his.
If Hu Tie's power is like an enraged beast, vigorous and heavy, with the strength to pull up a mountain, then Hu Tie's power is like Luo Zheng's.
But Luo Zheng's power is like the sea, vast and boundless, unfathomable.
"Bang!"
The moment the two powers collide, the winner is immediately decided.
Luo Zheng's punch consumes all of Hu Tie's impact. At the same time, a huge rebound force is transmitted to Hu Tie's body, causing him to retreat more than ten steps.
Hu Tie wants to stop himself, but Luo Zheng's power is endless. Soon, Hu Tie retreats to the edge of the arena. He steps on air and falls off the arena.
Another punch.
Just one punch.
In terms of strength against strength, Luo Zheng won completely.
Xiao Yufeng's disciples felt like their hearts were about to jump out of their chests.
Luo Zheng's performance today could be said to have completely subverted some of their perceptions of this world.
Now, Luo Zheng's performance could no longer be described as outstanding. If it had to be described, it could only be described as "monstrous."
Who would have thought that Hu Tie, who was known for his great strength, would also be knocked out of the ring by Luo Zheng with a single punch? What's more, Luo Zheng didn't use any tricks. Instead, he used an even more domineering force to counterattack.
Luo Zheng continued to move his arms and asked the people of Vulture Peak with an indifferent expression, "Who else?"
Hu Tie's skin was rough and his flesh was thick. Although he was knocked off the stage by Luo Zheng's punch, he wasn't injured at all. The expression on his face was very stubborn. He was still unconvinced. "Wait a minute, I wasn't prepared just now. I didn't expect your strength to be so great! I want to try again! "
"According to the rules of the challenge, you've already lost when you fell off the stage. Next." Luo Zheng shook his head. He had just returned to Xiao Yufeng today. What he wanted was to end the battle quickly. Naturally, he wouldn't agree to Hu Tie's request.
Subsequently, Vulture Peak sent out another person.
In two consecutive rounds, Luo Zheng defeated his opponent with only one punch.
This undoubtedly gave the outer sect disciples of Vulture Peak a great deal of pressure.
Although Luo Zheng was only at the Marrow Refining stage, the people of Vulture Peak had already completely stopped looking down on him.
Luo Zheng didn't rely on tricks or luck. Instead, he defeated Hu Tie with his true strength. This already proved that Luo Zheng's strength far surpassed his peers.
After the fourth person from Vulture Peak entered the ring, he was very cautious.
Unfortunately, Luo Zheng still didn't give him a chance.
Once again, he sent Vulture Peak's fourth challenger flying off the stage with one punch.
At the sight of this blood-boiling scene, all of the Little Rain Peak disciples present were unable to use words to describe their feelings. They could only shout with all their might. It was as if this was the only way to express their excitement.
A thousand feet away from the arena, there were two women standing on top of a small building, watching everything that was happening on the other side.
These two women were both outstanding beauties. They were devastatingly beautiful.
"Instructor Su, I'm going to die because of you! You asked me to lead some people to spur the outer sect disciples of Xiao Yufeng. Without another word, I led the elites of Vulture Peak here. Who knew that such a monster would appear on your peak … "The woman who spoke was surnamed Mu. Her name was Mu Qingyang. She was one of the instructors of Vulture Peak.
The challenge this time was actually arranged by these two mentors.
In order to motivate their disciples to train diligently and painstakingly, these instructors had practically used all the methods they could think of.
Wasn't the challenge of the peak a very effective method?
If Xiao Yufeng was defeated, it might affect the mood of these outer sect disciples, but it would make them understand that they had to work harder in order to catch up.
To achieve this, they had to truly understand that the weak had to be beaten. That was why Su Lingyun had agreed to Vulture Peak's challenge.
Su Lingyun pursed her lips and looked at Luo Zheng with a complicated expression. "This outer sect disciple received a mission from me and left Xiao Yufeng to go to the south to kill saber bugs. "What? A Marrow Refining Realm disciple went to kill saber bugs? Did I hear it wrong? But the strength that this boy has shown is indeed enough to accept this mission. "Mu Qingyang looked at the arena with a helpless expression." This boy is too merciless. His attacks are so ruthless. He only uses one punch every time! "
Hearing Mu Qingyang's words, Su Lingyun suddenly felt a little proud. She smiled and said, "Sister Qingyang, that's your Vulture Peak's disciple. He's too weak!"

Liu Cunshi ranks first in our Vulture Peak and is already a Primordial Spirit. As long as Liu Cunshi comes out, Luo Zheng won't be able to win, "Mu Qingyang said.

Not to mention Primordial Spirit, even many outer sect disciples who were half a step to the Primordial Spirit were promoted.
Mu Qingyang smiled and said, "Are you saying that only your Xiao Yufeng can have geniuses? Can't our Vulture Peak have any? Liu Cunshi has only been in our Vulture Peak for half a year, but he has already broken through. We haven't had time to transfer him to the inner sect, so he's naturally an outer sect disciple now. "
Primordial Spirit? Su Lingyun felt a little conflicted. On the one hand, she really wanted to see whether Luo Zheng could defeat a Primordial Spirit. On the other hand, she didn't want Luo Zheng to win.
"Alas, let's wait and see." Su Lingyun sighed in her heart.
In the arena, there was one more person opposite Luo Zheng. This was the fifth person sent by Vulture Peak. He should be the strongest outer sect disciple of Vulture Peak.
Liu Cunshi, a Primordial Spirit.
Liu Cunshi's appearance was very ordinary. He didn't seem to have any imposing manner. If he was thrown on the street, he was the kind of person who couldn't be found at a glance.
After Liu Cunshi entered the arena, the outer sect disciples of Xiao Yufeng realized that they were probably going to win this challenge. This Liu Cunshi in front of them couldn't be compared to the disciples sent by Vulture Peak before.
However, when Liu Cunshi condensed his Vital Essence and formed a ring in his hand, everyone's expression changed drastically.
"Primordial Spirit! This guy is actually a Primordial Spirit! He's an outer sect disciple? "

Many people looked at the black-robed people who were watching the fight. Although these black-robed people stood proudly not far away, they were Xiao Yufeng's inner sect disciples after all. At this moment, they should be the ones to step forward.
Primordial Spirit was a threshold for warriors.
The difference between Vital Essence and Vital Essence was also like heaven and earth.
Luo Zheng had indeed defeated the three people on Vulture Peak with one punch each.
However, to fight a Primordial Spirit, one had to be a Primordial Spirit first. Otherwise, this challenge would be too unfair.
Therefore, the crowd began to clamor.
"Liu Cunshi is the number one outer sect disciple of Vulture Peak. He just entered the Primordial Spirit not long ago and hasn't had time to advance to the inner sect! Naturally, he's an outer sect disciple. How can he break the rules? If you can't compete, then don't compete. Just admit defeat! " Liu Cunshi was the biggest backer of Vulture Peak. When they heard Xiao Yufeng's words, they naturally rebutted.
The two sides couldn't agree and the scene became chaotic again.
However, the two people on the stage completely ignored the commotion below the stage.
The ring in Liu Cunshi's hand spun slowly. He said, "You are indeed very strong. You defeated three half-step Primordial Spirit disciples of Vulture Peak consecutively. I, Liu Cunshi, have never heard of such a battle record."
"Thank you for the compliment." Luo Zheng cupped his hands and said.
"However, this is the end of it. Although I challenge you with the advantage of being a Xiantian lifeform, which is a bit of a bully, I must win today's mountain challenge. Otherwise, the entire Vulture Peak's outer door will have no face to stand in the Blue Cloud Sect," Liu Cunshi said in a calm tone. There was no excitement in his tone, nor contempt, as if he was a person chatting with you.
Faced with such an attitude, Luo Zheng smiled calmly. "Then I hope Brother Cunshi will go easy on me in the following exchange."
"Don't worry. I will only make you lose the ability to resist. I won't hurt you!"

Chapter 69
This wasn't the first time Luo Zheng had faced a Xiantian lifeform.
A few days ago, he'd used a broken throwing knife to kill the Black White Double Demons.
However, it had to be said that his broken throwing knife had played a huge role in killing the Black White Double Demons.
But now, they were in the arena.
Although the Blue Cloud Sect didn't restrict the use of weapons in the arena, when a broken throwing knife was used, there was bound to be blood. Luo Zheng didn't want to appear too bloodthirsty in this kind of mountain-level challenge.
The golden ring was condensed from True Essence, but it flickered with a metallic luster. It floated in the air and buzzed.
When the ring flew in front of Luo Zheng, it suddenly expanded, wanting to encircle Luo Zheng.
"Come on!"
Luo Zheng's body flashed with a purple light, and he fiercely punched the golden ring.
"Clang!"
With this punch, the golden ring made a crisp sound. It suddenly changed from a circular ring to a deflated one. Luo Zheng sent it flying fifty or sixty feet away, out of the arena.
Liu Cunshi smiled slightly. He reached out with his hand, and the golden ring flashed with a golden light. It immediately returned to its original shape, and continued to encircle Luo Zheng.
Not only that, but True Essence circulated around Liu Cunshi's body. Another golden ring appeared in his hand, and it also went to encircle Luo Zheng.
"Clang! Clang! "
Luo Zheng still struck out twice, making these strange rings unable to get close to him.
But soon, Luo Zheng understood Liu Cunshi's intentions.
Liu Cunshi stood in place, continuously waving his hands. One golden ring after another continuously appeared in his hands.
After a few breaths, seven golden rings were flying above the arena.
Although Luo Zheng continuously used his heavy punches to knock these rings away, once there were too many of them, Luo Zheng couldn't deal with them all.
Finally, a golden ring took advantage of a gap in Luo Zheng's attack. Together with Luo Zheng's arms, it encircled Luo Zheng.
"You want to use this thing to trap me?"
Luo Zheng exerts his strength with both hands, trying to break free from the restraints of the ring.
With his current strength, he wouldn't be at a disadvantage even if he were to face a Xiantian lifeform head on. Presumably, this golden hoop would shatter into pieces if he were to struggle.
This golden hoop was indeed unable to withstand Luo Zheng's strength. As Luo Zheng struggled to break free, faint cracks appeared on the golden hoop. But at this moment, the other golden hoop encircled Luo Zheng one by one.
If one golden ring couldn't withstand Luo Zheng's power, two golden rings wouldn't be able to withstand it either.
However, when the seven golden rings tightly bound Luo Zheng, the combined power of the ten golden rings made it difficult for Luo Zheng to break free.
It was just like how it was easy to break a chopstick, but hard to break a pair of chopsticks.
After being bound by these golden rings, Luo Zheng took a deep breath and shouted in a low voice.
The power of the seven dragon scales immediately blossomed with a jade-green light. Surging power surged from his body, the veins all over his body bulging.
Even when he exerted all his strength, the golden rings still wouldn't budge!
Liu Cunshi strolled over and smiled. "You can't break free. Even a Xiantian lifeform has no way of breaking free after being bound by my Binding Sky Hoop. Although your strength is far greater than others of the same level, you still can't break free. You've already lost."
The people of Vulture Peak all let out a deep breath when they saw this.
The people from Vulture Peak had seen Liu Cunshi's Tian Huan many times before.
Before Liu Cunshi had stepped into the Xiantian realm, just the Binding Sky Hoop formed from his true qi was already incomparably sturdy. No one on Vulture Peak could break it.
Now that Liu Cunshi was a Xiantian lifeform, the Binding Sky Hoop formed from his true qi was like a real object. There was no way that Marrow Refining kid could break free.
Luo Zheng was trapped in place. He tried twice and found that he couldn't break free, so he gave up. But at the same time, a smile appeared on his face. "Does it mean I've lost if you bind me like this?"

There were only two ways to lose an arena battle. The first was to knock the opponent down so that they couldn't get up. The second was to be thrown off the arena.
Hearing Luo Zheng's words, Liu Cunshi's face showed faint mockery. Playing such petty tricks in this situation? "Then I'll just throw you off the arena!"
Liu Cunshi pointed with a finger. The golden hoop binding Luo Zheng made a buzzing sound, then dragged Luo Zheng to the edge of the arena.
But just as Luo Zheng was moved to the edge of the arena, Liu Cunshi suddenly felt a sharp pain in his head. This pain came from the soul, and he almost fainted on the ground.
"Ah!"
Liu Cunshi held his head and uttered a miserable cry.
The change in the arena made the onlookers a little confused.
Especially Xiao Yufeng's disciples. Seeing Luo Zheng being bound so easily, most of them had already accepted the fact that Luo Zheng had lost.
Liu Cunshi was a Xiantian lifeform after all. Losing to him was not an injustice!

Xiao Yufeng's disciples discussed one after another, but no one was able to get to the point.
On the contrary, the black-robed inner disciples of Xiao Yufeng who came to watch the fight saw some clues.

But when I came to the Blue Cloud Sect, I finally understood the meaning of the phrase 'there is always someone better than you' …"
Luo Zheng's attention was now focused on Liu Cunshi. Naturally, he didn't hear Yu Quan's sigh.
Liu Cunshi covered his head for a long time and finally got over the pain. His calm face was now full of anger. At the same time, he showed a deep fear of Luo Zheng.
In Liu Cunshi's view, he and Luo Zheng were not at the same level.
Even if this guy's performance was very amazing, especially the fact that he was only in the Marrow Refining Realm, it was very precious.
But he was a Xiantian lifeform.
Below the Xiantian lifeforms were all living beings.
He was like a fully armed adult, and Luo Zheng was like a little brat who hadn't experienced the world.
With the power of his vital essence, he could easily crush Luo Zheng.
He didn't even use any killing moves. He just wanted to use Shu Tian Huan to tie up Luo Zheng and throw him off the arena.
However, just when he thought that this competition was going to end without any suspense, Luo Zheng gave him a fierce blow.
The pain of his soul being injured was unforgettable for Liu Cunshi.
Therefore, after he regained his senses, he quickly retreated.
While Liu Cunshi was retreating, a broken throwing knife appeared in Luo Zheng's hand. The broken throwing knife jumped into Luo Zheng's hand, spun around, and then nimbly pulled upward. "Ping, ping, ping, ping …" Several sounds were heard.

Seeing Luo Zheng's broken throwing knife, Liu Cunshi's eyebrows suddenly rose. This guy actually had such a sharp throwing knife. Why didn't he use it before?
He didn't know that Luo Zheng didn't plan to use the broken throwing knife to fight. After cutting these Shu Tian Huan, Luo Zheng casually stuffed them back into his Sumeru Ring. With a smile on his face, he said, "It seems that the outcome of this match is a bit difficult to determine."
"Interesting!" From the beginning, Liu Cunshi also didn't plan to use his full strength. However, Luo Zheng's performance just now had made Liu Cunshi take him seriously.
Faint golden vital essence seeped out of his skin, and the vital essence began to slowly condense again.
"Since you insist on creating more problems, I'll show you the true strength of a Xiantian lifeform! Splitting Sky Ring! "
As soon as Liu Cunshi's voice fell, another golden ring formed in his hand. However, the shape of this golden ring was somewhat different from that of the Shu Tian Huan. The golden ring was covered with neat sawteeth, and at the same time, it was constantly rotating at high speed.

The seven Splitting Sky Rings flew over from seven different angles.
Two Heaven Splitting Rings flew high into the air, drawing a parabola in the air.
The other three Splitting Sky Rings shot towards Luo Zheng in a straight line.
The remaining two Sky Splitting Rings followed the ground of the arena and slashed towards Luo Zheng's legs. As the two Sky Splitting Rings rolled across the arena, the arena became like mud as the Sky Splitting Rings left deep grooves in its wake.
Facing these seven Splitting Sky Rings, Luo Zheng's expression was very nervous.

Chapter 70
"Ah, Liu Cunshi has gone too far. It's just a mountain challenge, but he used such a ruthless move. Does he want Luo Zheng's life?"
"The arena is made of fine iron. It's as soft as mud under the cutting of the Golden Ring! If it were a knife, wouldn't he be beheaded? "
"It's too dangerous. How will Luo Zheng deal with it?"
Now, everyone was sweating for Luo Zheng.
Just as the Sky Splitting Rings were about to reach Luo Zheng, his body suddenly twisted strangely. He actually went around the three Sky Splitting Rings in the middle.
At the same time, he used the momentum of his charge to dodge the four Sky Splitting Rings above and below him. He quickly took a step forward and charged towards Liu Cunshi.
The previous round of fighting between the two was only the prelude. Now, it was the real fight.
Liu Cunshi looked at Luo Zheng, who was rushing toward him. He didn't panic at all, but his expression became more and more serious. He waved his hand, and the seven Sky Splitting Rings behind Luo Zheng changed their direction and swept toward Luo Zheng.
The seven Sky Splitting Rings were transformed by Vital Essence. They were as light as a feather and flew extremely fast.
Although Luo Zheng's speed was also very fast, if he didn't dodge, Luo Zheng would be cut into pieces before he could get close to Liu Cunshi.
This was why Liu Cunshi was so calm. He was sure that Luo Zheng didn't dare to use his body to bear the damage of the Sky Splitting Rings.
But this time, Liu Cunshi was wrong.
If Luo Zheng was still a Xuanji Body, he would be very afraid of the cutting power of the Sky Splitting Rings.

Why didn't he dodge now? Did he want to die?

We can lose this challenge, but Luo Zheng can't throw his life away!

For the people of Vulture Peak, this was a pretty good result.

This kind of thing had happened before.
Two years ago, Jade Maiden Peak's genius disciple Luo Yan had appeared out of nowhere and bathed the sixth ranked Tenshou Peak in blood. "Clang!"
"Clang!"
"Clang!"
Every time the Sky Splitting Ring hit Luo Zheng's back, it would make a loud noise.

However, Liu Cunshi was not an ordinary person.
If he had only relied on hard work to enter the Connate Mystic Realm, he might have only become a very mediocre inner sect disciple of Vulture Peak.
However, he was now the number one outer sect disciple of Vulture Peak!
To become the number one outer sect disciple of any of the 33 peaks of Qingyun Peak, it was simply impossible to rely on hard work and hard work to become the number one outer sect disciple.
Liu Cunshi was an absolute genius of Vulture Peak. He was now the number one outer sect disciple and would also become the number one inner sect disciple in the future!
Luo Zheng sent Liu Cunshi flying out of the arena with one punch, but his feet did not touch the ground. He was still in mid-air. According to the rules, he had not lost yet.
In mid-air, Liu Cunshi waved his hand and sent the Thick Earth Ring in his hand flying out.
The Thick Earth Ring hit the ground beside the arena at an extremely fast speed, then bounced off the wall and flew back towards Liu Cunshi.
Liu Cunshi straightened his body and tapped his feet in the middle of the Thick Earth Ring. With the rebounding force of the Thick Earth Ring, he flew back towards the arena.
"Beautiful! Senior Brother Cunshi's flying back and forth is perfect! "
"Indeed, in our Vulture Peak, only Liu Cunshi can remain calm in such a situation!"
"To send his Thick Earth Ring out at such a time, and to calculate the angle and strength, this is not something that ordinary people can do."
The hearts of the Vulture Peak group sank when they saw Liu Cunshi being sent out of the arena. They thought that the mountain challenge was over. But at this critical moment, Liu Cunshi's move pushed him back into the arena. They immediately cheered.
At this time, Luo Zheng had gained the upper hand. He definitely did not want Liu Cunshi to return to the arena easily.
Before Liu Cunshi landed, Luo Zheng had flashed to the edge of the arena. He raised his fists and suddenly smashed them towards Liu Cunshi, who was rushing towards him.
Liu Cunshi had nothing to rely on in the air. Seeing Luo Zheng's aggressiveness, he was really depressed. He really did not want to confront Luo Zheng directly. He did not know how this guy cultivated his strength. It was too amazing.
Unfortunately, he had no choice but to crash into Luo Zheng.
Liu Cunshi had no choice but to use the Thick Earth Ring in front of him again.
The result was the same as last time. Liu Cunshi was sent out of the arena by Luo Zheng before he could touch the ground.
Liu Cunshi was not willing to give up. He used the same method to push himself back into the arena with the rebounding force of the Thick Earth Ring.
Therefore, a very strange scene played out in the arena.
Liu Cunshi desperately wanted to get back into the arena, but Luo Zheng did not let him.
No matter which side of the arena Liu Cunshi rebounded to, Luo Zheng would be one step ahead of him and send Liu Cunshi flying out with a punch.
Liu Cunshi was like a grasshopper that could not land on the ground, jumping around in the air above the arena.
The first and second time the two of them fought like this was thrilling. Everyone held their breath and did not dare to speak.
But the third, fourth, and fifth time … it was the same. Everyone was speechless.
Mu Qingyang and Su Lingyun, who were watching the battle from afar, were also speechless. They watched the strange battle in the arena and could not speak for a long time.
After a long time, Mu Qingyang gritted his teeth and said, "Lingyun, that outer disciple called Luo Zheng is too much. How can he treat Liu Cunshi like a child's ball and throw him into the air? Come down!"
Su Lingyun stroked her black hair behind her head and said, "Well … I think Luo Zheng is also afraid of Liu Cunshi's strength. After all, he is a Connate lifeform and has too much of an advantage."
"But it can't go on like this!" Mu Qingyang was a little anxious.
A crafty smile appeared on Su Lingyun's face. She was naturally not anxious. After all, she had already thought it through. She was already prepared to lose this mountain peak challenge. However, if she coincidentally won, she would not reject it.
Of course, Mu Qingyang was anxious.
Although Liu Cunshi was a Connate lifeform, he had just stepped into the Connate Secret Realm. The Vital Essence in his body was not unlimited. If this continued, Liu Cunshi was likely to be defeated.
Since Mu Qingyang realized this, Liu Cunshi, as the person involved, naturally realized it as well.
Even if he could block Luo Zheng's strength with the Thick Earth Ring, he would not fall to the ground at the same time.
But if this continued, the Vital Essence in his body would dry up, and he would be defeated in the end.
Liu Cunshi absolutely could not accept this result.
Therefore, when he was sent flying by Luo Zheng for the ninth time and rushed to the arena for the ninth time with the help of the Thick Earth Ring, the Vital Essence in his body surged again. This time, he had almost exhausted all the Vital Essence in his body!
He wanted to fight with all his strength!

Chapter 71
In mid-air, Liu Cunshi looked like a Heavenly Venerate. His entire body glowed with golden light. His aura was like a huge mountain crashing down.
A small portion of the weaker outer court disciples on Little Rain Peak felt their legs go soft under the pressure of this pressure, and they actually sat down on the ground.
Liu Cunshi's golden light eventually turned into a huge golden ring. It covered the entire arena and enclosed it within.
Then, Liu Cunshi stepped on the edge of the golden ring. He stretched out his hands and made a few gestures. At the same time, he muttered something.
"World Annihilation Ring! Break! "
Those who could enter the Connate Mystic Realm and surpass the human lifespan were all intelligent people. Naturally, they also had some trump cards.
And the World Annihilation Ring was Liu Cunshi's trump card.
This World Annihilation Ring consumed a lot of vital essence.
Although Liu Cunshi still had about 50% of his vital essence left, the moment he used the Annihilation Ring, the vital essence in his body was completely drained. He was standing at the edge of the Annihilation Ring. His face was deathly pale, and he could not even stand properly.
Deep down, he was very unwilling to use his trump card in such a situation.
He was more willing to save the World Annihilation Ring for the Sect Competition. If he exposed his trump card now, others would naturally be on guard when they fought him in the future.
But he had no better idea now.
Other than using the World Annihilation Ring, he could not think of any other way to turn the situation around.
What made Liu Cunshi even more unwilling was that he had been forced to use his trump card by a Marrow Refining Stage brat.
Marrow Refining Stage …
In Liu Cunshi's mind, this brat was someone he could easily crush with his fist. But he had been forced into such a state …
For a moment, Liu Cunshi could not accept this outcome.
"Since you want to die so badly, I'll fulfill your wish!"
Liu Cunshi, who had not intended to kill Luo Zheng, now wanted nothing more than for Luo Zheng to die quickly.
Of course, he was still rather confident in the World Annihilation Ring. Even a Connate lifeform would be severely injured if not killed in it. Liu Cunshi did not believe that Luo Zheng could survive this ordeal!
The entire World Annihilation Ring started to emit a magnificent color. Waves of vital essence started to gather in the arena.
For this move to carry the word "Armageddon", it truly had the power to destroy the heavens and earth.
However, Liu Cunshi was only at the first stage of the Xiantian Realm after all. When the World Extermination Ring was released, it could only delimit a relatively small area and then destroy all the living forces within the ring.
If Liu Cunshi's strength were to advance to the next level and break through the Connate stage, reaching a higher realm, one World-Destroying Ring would probably be able to wipe out all the living beings on a mountain.
When the energy in the World Annihilation Ring reached its limit, it suddenly flashed with a magnificent golden light and shot into the sky with a loud explosion.
This World Annihilation Ring was very unique. It was able to concentrate all the power within the ring. Even if one stood close to the ring, they would not be affected at all.
Because of this, the energy within the World Annihilation Ring was even more concentrated and powerful.
The outer sect disciples on the Xiao Yufeng paled when they saw the power of the World Annihilation Ring.
The interior of the World Extermination Ring was simply hell. Under such an attack, Luo Zheng's body would most likely be ground to dust.
Most people understood that Luo Zheng would probably not be able to survive this time.
As the golden light continued to flash, the crowd could not see the situation inside the World Annihilation Ring. At this moment, they could do nothing but pray that Luo Zheng could survive.
After a few breaths, the power of the World Annihilation Ring gradually dissipated. The golden light that had gathered in the arena also slowly faded away.
The first thing that was revealed to the crowd was the edge of the arena.
The entire arena had actually been washed away by the energy waves of the World Annihilation Ring. The arena, which had been made of refined iron, was now full of holes and deformed.
As for Luo Zheng, he was nowhere to be found. He had probably been ground to dust long ago …
It was too tragic.
However, just as the golden light on the arena completely dissipated, a figure suddenly rushed out.
The man was naked and covered with wounds, but he was extremely fast. He rushed to the edge of the ring and punched Liu Cunshi, who was on the verge of death.
All of Liu Cunshi's vital essence had been used up. At this moment, he could not even stand straight. Faced with this punch, he had no way to avoid it. He was directly smashed out of the arena and lay on the ground, unconscious.
The completely naked man was none other than Luo Zheng.
Relying on his body of spiritual qi, he had taken all of the World Annihilation Ring's attacks head-on.
Liu Cunshi's attack made Luo Zheng feel some lingering fear.
Although he knew very well how terrifying a Connate lifeform was, he had not been in such a sorry state when he had killed the Black White Double Ghosts in the Dragon Castle by himself.
Thinking about it carefully, Luo Zheng had relied on the advantage of the broken flying dagger to kill the Twin Ghosts of Black and White when they least expected it. At that time, the Twin Ghosts of Black and White had not had time to display their true strength. They did not even have time to use the weapons in their hands before their heads were separated from their bodies.
If not for that, Luo Zheng would not have been confident of defeating the Black White Double Ghosts.
Vulture Peak's number one outer disciple, Liu Cunshi, had been defeated.
Up to this point, Luo Zheng had single-handedly defeated the four outer disciples of Vulture Peak. He had forcibly turned Xiao Yufeng's dispirited situation around.
At this moment, many outer disciples were still unaware of what had happened. They were only immersed in the fact that "Luo Zheng is still alive."

"Luo Zheng! Luo Zheng! "
"Luo Zheng! Luo Zheng! "

All of his clothes had been shredded to dust by the energy of the World Destruction Ring. At this moment, he was completely naked. Although Xiao Yufeng was full of male disciples, it was still indecent for him to be naked in front of everyone.
Zhou Xian was the first to notice Luo Zheng's awkward expression. He hurriedly took off his outer robe and threw it to Luo Zheng in the arena.
Luo Zheng used the white outer robe to cover his body before jumping down from the arena. Accompanied by Mo Can and Zhou Xian, he walked over to Zhang Wuxian.

"Brother Wuxian, do you feel alright now?" Luo Zheng asked.

He had not been friends with Luo Zheng for long, but he could already see that Luo Zheng's future strength was limitless. This was also one of the reasons why he had taken the initiative to befriend Luo Zheng. Their Zhang family was very sensitive in this aspect.

He was only in the Marrow Refining Realm, yet he had defeated Liu Cunshi!
Moreover, he had taken Liu Cunshi's trump card head-on.
If Zhang Wuxian's guess was correct, Luo Zheng also had trump cards that he had not used. Because of this, Luo Zheng's image in Zhang Wuxian's mind became even more unfathomable.
"Serious? Haha, even if I'm seriously injured, it's worth it to see Brother Luo Zheng's performance! " Zhang Wuxian laughed heartily. However, when he laughed, two of his broken ribs were pulled. Immediately, he felt a burst of pain. He covered his chest and could not speak.
At this moment, the Outer Core Disciples near the arena gathered around one after another. Everyone's face was filled with joy.
In fact, in the minds of these Outer Core Disciples, it was not important that they had won the Vulture Peak and received the double reward. What was important was that there was a Luo Zheng in Xiao Yufeng!
In the attic not far away.
Mu Qingyang's face was ashen at this moment.
She clenched her silver teeth and said bitterly, "Well, don't cover your eyes. That guy has put on his clothes."
Su Lingyun slowly removed her hands from her face and said with a sly smile, "Sister Mu, I'm sorry this time!"

Liu Cunshi is the proudest disciple of our Outer Core Disciples. Now that he has lost to a junior in the Marrow Refining Realm, he must have suffered a great blow. His temperament must have been affected. "Mu Qingyang said gloomily.
Actually, Mu Qingyang did not care about this matter. However, Liu Cunshi was a disciple that she had focused on cultivating.
Now that he had been severely defeated by Luo Zheng, Liu Cunshi's heart to practice martial arts had been greatly damaged. In the future, the speed of his progress would be greatly reduced, which was the most terrible thing.
Su Lingyun said seriously, "On the path of martial arts, everyone is bound to meet strong enemies. If his heart to practice martial arts is so easily damaged, it means that he is too arrogant. People have to accept appropriate blows. Only those who can climb back up after a blow are truly strong, right? "
Hearing Su Lingyun's words, Mu Qingyang did not express his opinion.
Mu Qingyang had to admit that her words made sense. The most important part of practicing martial arts was one's temperament. If one's path was smooth sailing, once he suffered a setback, it would be difficult for him to climb back up.
On the contrary, those who suffered continuous failures but still tried their best to forge ahead were qualified to have the last laugh.
However, Su Lingyun's words at this moment were suspicious of her taking advantage of the situation.
Seeing that Mu Qingyang was still unhappy, Su Lingyun comforted her with a smile, "Well, Sister Mu, if there is a chance in the future, I will definitely make it up to you!"
Mu Qingyang pursed her lips. Thinking of Su Lingyun's identity, it was not bad for her to owe him a favor. Since the matter had come to this, there was no way to remedy it.

Everyone was talking about Luo Zheng's performance in the arena with great interest.

Early in the morning, Luo Zheng got out of bed and washed himself up from head to toe.

Fighting Liu Cunshi like this was quite beneficial to Luo Zheng.

To be able to come back from the south, Luo Zheng must have gained a lot.

At that time, when Luo Zheng had insisted on going south to complete the mission of killing the blade insects, Su Lingyun felt that the risk was too great, and that Luo Zheng was too impatient.

At this stage, the points wouldn't be of much use to Luo Zheng.

Su Lingyun's thin lips curled even more. She didn't expect that Luo Zheng would actually get so many blade insect leader's points. Counting it this way, these two crystal cores could be exchanged for nearly 500 points. For an outer disciple, 500 points was quite a lot.
"Mm, adding it all up, it can be exchanged for almost 500 points. Your harvest in the south this time was indeed good, but 500 points can't do much in the Blue Cloud Sect …"
Women were all stingy. Even though Su Lingyun's status was high, her eyes narrowed slightly, and her words were still full of sarcasm.

The fist-sized demon beast crystal core flickered with a purple light. That was the Blade Insect Queen's crystal core.

But what was the deal with the Blade Insect Queen's demon beast crystal core?
If Luo Zheng encountered the Blade Insect Queen, he probably had no other choice but to run away.
Could it be that some powerful figure had killed the Blade Insect Queen, and then gave the Blade Insect Queen's demon beast crystal core to Luo Zheng?
This was unlikely. A Blade Insect Queen's demon beast crystal core was worth 1000 points, which was equivalent to 2000 square crystal stones. No matter who it was, it was not a small value.
Luo Zheng had no power or influence. Who would give this thing to him?

Su Lingyun had asked this question when Luo Zheng accepted the mission.

Chapter 73
The two stood face to face just like that, the atmosphere stiff.
Su Lingyun grew up in the Li Palace next to Burning Sky Palace. As her highness, how many people dared to go against her?

Right now, Su Lingyun was on the verge of erupting in anger.

Luo Zheng walked down the mountain ridge, following Xiao Yufeng's mountain path. Then, he found Purgatory Mountain's direction, directly heading in that direction.

Just now, before Luo Zheng took the disciple card, Su Lingyun had tampered with Luo Zheng's disciple card, so that she could capture the image of Luo Zheng with this letter tablet.

Northwest …
There was Purgatory Mountain in the northwest!

Meanwhile, in this Purgatory Mountain, there were almost no rules to speak of, this was a world where the strong preyed on the weak.
For those with weak strength, apart from being fish on the chopping block of the strong, there was almost no other way out.
Those with great strength could occupy a peak in Purgatory Mountain, do as they pleased.
There were some genius disciples in the Blue Cloud Sect who, for the sake of increasing their own experience, even purposely roamed Purgatory Mountain to gain experience!
These two mountain guardians didn't warn everyone like this either. They saw that Luo Zheng's cultivation was too low, only at the Marrow Refinement Realm, moreover not knowing much about Purgatory Mountain, that was why they said a few more words.
"I understand, but I must enter." Luo Zheng raised his head to look into the distance, but he didn't know where Luo Yan was locked up in Purgatory Mountain.
Since Luo Zheng himself already spoke like this, the two mountain guardians didn't say anything else either. After returning the disciple tile to Luo Zheng, the two of them moved aside.
Then, Luo Zheng began to move, stepping into that line.
After walking along that black gravel path, roughly two li later, Luo Zheng finally arrived at the foot of the mountain.
In front of him was an extremely steep mountain path. Meanwhile, the two sides of the mountain path released dark red radiance from time to time, as if there were flames roasting the pure black rocks on the mountain.
Without thinking too much, Luo Zheng began to climb towards Purgatory Mountain.
Purgatory Mountain was a living volcano.
Along the way, one could see craters from time to time.
There were some craters that were covered in a deathly gray color, while there were some craters that had surging magma.
Near those craters, Luo Zheng discovered quite a few people. These should all be Blue Cloud Sect disciples who were sent to Purgatory Mountain as punishment.
These Blue Cloud Sect disciples weren't weak.
There was no lack of Xiantian lifeforms among them!
There were some who released auras that were even more powerful than He Tiancheng's.
Most of the Xiantian lifeforms among them had lifeless appearances. When they saw Luo Zheng pass by, they didn't react at all.
However, there were still some Xiantian lifeforms who, after noticing Luo Zheng, cast him looks that carried ill intentions. There were even some who followed behind Luo Zheng.
When he saw this, Luo Zheng fished out the damaged flying knife from his spatial ring, holding it in his hand.

Chapter 74
Luo Zheng adjusted his vigilance to the highest level. His legs moved, increasing his speed as he crazily ran up the mountain!
When the people tailing Luo Zheng noticed that Luo Zheng increased his speed, they thought that Luo Zheng wanted to escape. At the same time, they also increased their speed.
One of them even moved with extreme speed from the mountain path to the side, blocking Luo Zheng's path.
"Hahaha, since when did a Marrow Refinement Realm brat dare step foot into Purgatory Mountain? With such fine skin and tender flesh, it's perfect for you to stay behind and accompany this daddy! " This was a dark faced man who seemed to be over thirty years old. His face was fierce-looking, his skin dark, and his pair of bean-sized eyes released a dangerous glint.

Obediently listen to this daddy's words, and you can still live for two more days. Otherwise, a trifling Marrow Refinement Realm brat like you will be finished off at any time!"
When the people tailing Luo Zheng saw that the dark faced man took the initiative to attack, they all became motionless.

The dark faced man didn't take Luo Zheng's warning to heart in the slightest. In the eyes of these Purgatory Mountain people, a Marrow Refinement Realm brat wasn't worth fearing at all. No matter how strict the warning was, it was still like the howling of a kitten. What was there to be scared of?
As a result, the dark faced man reached out his large black hand in an unbridled manner, squeezing towards Luo Zheng. From the looks of it, he wanted to capture Luo Zheng.
If he fell into this dark faced man's hands, he would definitely suffer a fate worse than death!
In this instant, the dusky soul spike between Luo Zheng's brows shot towards the dark faced man Meng Zha.
"Spirit Shocking Stab!"

At the same time, the damaged throwing knife that had always been in Luo Zheng's hands suddenly shot out!
Xiu!
"Pu!"

Then, Luo Zheng's finger lightly hooked, and the invisible string pulled the flying knife back. It circled once before Luo Zheng caught it in his hand.

Purgatory Mountain, mountain peak.

Every blade could leave a destructive wound on the Demon General's body.
At this moment, Luo Zheng was like the most barbaric butcher, desperately waving his Flying Dagger and dismembering the Demon General in a frenzy.
It was said that the Demon Clan's vitality was extremely tenacious. No matter how serious the injury, they could recover in a short period of time.
"Kill, kill, kill, kill, kill!"
"I'll kill you while you're sick!"
Since Luo Zheng had succeeded in one move, he would not give the Demon General any chance to revive.
Only when the Demon General's head, arms, and body had been cut into pieces of flesh and blood did Luo Zheng stop and gasp for breath.
The Demon General had been cut into pieces by Luo Zheng. Obviously, he was dead, and there was absolutely no possibility of recovery.
Seeing this, the surrounding Demon Soldiers retreated and fled in all directions.
Luo Zheng's body was stained with Demon Blood. His whole body was like that of a Demon Clan, emitting a strong killing intent.
Xiao Yufeng's disciples stared blankly at Luo Zheng with a trace of fear in their eyes.
This fear was not because of the remaining Demon Aura on Luo Zheng's body, but because Luo Zheng's performance just now was too frightening. He was like a crazy demon god!
Although Luo Zheng was only a half-step Xiantian, the Demon Aura emitted from his body made those Xiantian lifeforms feel fear!
Lin Geng sheathed his sword and slowly walked over. He glanced at the wound on Luo Zheng's shoulder, then took out a small bottle from his waist. He took out a pill from the bottle and threw it to Luo Zheng. At the same time, he said, "This is the Muscle Growing Pill from the Heavenly Fragrance Pavilion. Catch it."
Luo Zheng did not hesitate. He took the pill and stuffed it into his mouth.
Although this Muscle Growing Pill was not as good as the Red Cloud Pill given to him by Instructor Su, it was still a very expensive pill for Inner Sect disciples.
Previously, when Luo Zheng had just walked down from the giant Flying Chariot, Lin Geng and the others had been mocking Luo Zheng. But now, they were saved by Luo Zheng.
Lin Geng was willing to take out the Muscle Growing Pill because he felt a little apologetic.
The disciple surnamed Qiu and a few other inner disciples walked over to the corpses of the demon soldiers and reached out to pluck a gray bead from the corpses.
"Yao core!"
Seeing the gray bead, Luo Zheng narrowed his eyes.
The bodies of demons and humans were completely different. The power of humans came from their Dantian, while the power of demons came from their Dantian.
The assessment for this mission was based on the number of Monster Cores collected. Therefore, even though they had lost two people, they didn't forget to collect these Monster Cores.
The disciple surnamed Qiu silently collected the Monster Cores, and obediently handed four of them over to Luo Zheng.
These four Monster Cores had been killed by Luo Zheng.
The disciple surnamed Qiu had seen Luo Zheng's true strength and naturally didn't dare to have the slightest bit of greed.
Lin Geng raised his sword and stabbed the chest of the demon general on the ground. He also plucked out a Monster Core from the chest.
This demon general's Monster Core was one size larger than that of an ordinary demon soldier. Lin Geng said, "Brother Luo Zheng, this is the demon general's Monster Core. Take it!"
Luo Zheng put away the demon general's Monster Core and the four demon soldiers' Monster Cores into his sumeru ring.
If he could obtain first place in this mission, in addition to the mid-grade spirit weapon, he could also obtain a considerable amount of points.
Although the inner disciples of the 33 peaks, especially the Lone Sky Peak and Black Rock Peak, were quite strong, Luo Zheng wouldn't give up the opportunity to compete.
After this battle, Xiao Yufeng had lost two people, an outer disciple and an inner disciple.
"Sigh, it's just a pity that Xu Heng and Yang Hu were swallowed alive by that demon soldier," an inner disciple said in a muffled voice.
Lin Geng shook his head. "In the past, when we participated in demon-slaying missions, there were also people who encountered demon generals. That time, the demon-slaying mission ended miserably. A total of 120 disciples from 12 peaks died at the demon general's hands. This time, if it weren't for Brother Luo Zheng, none of us would have survived."
Encountering the attack of a demon general and several dozen demon soldiers, eight out of ten people were lucky enough to survive. This was already a great fortune amidst misfortune.
Hao Shige's attitude towards Luo Zheng was already very different.
With Hao Shige's intelligence, he thought he could clearly see through the various states of the human world and understand how enchanting the world was. There was always a mountain higher than the other. However, the arrogance in his bones was indeed difficult to erase.
However, participating in this demon-slaying mission had indeed taught him a hard lesson, making him clearly understand his own position.
This could also be considered a kind of tempering, a tempering of the mind.
After cleaning up the mess, the remaining eight people continued on their journey.
At this time, the mentality of Xiao Yufeng's disciples had already changed.
In the past, those inner sect disciples all regarded the outer sect disciples as burdens and burdens.
But now, everyone already understood that the true leader of this team was Luo Zheng.
Even Lin Geng himself thought so.
They slowly shuttled through the Canopy Forest. Until the sun set and night came, they didn't encounter any more demons.
"Demon beasts will appear at night. I think it's better for everyone to find a place to rest," Lin Geng suggested as he walked to the side of the team.
Luo Zheng nodded. "It's indeed not suitable to wander around at night."
"There's a fire ahead!" Guo Zirao suddenly shouted at this time.
Everyone looked ahead. In the distance, there was indeed a bonfire burning fiercely.
If there was a bonfire, it meant there were humans. They should be disciples from other peaks.
This demon-slaying mission involved a demon general. Naturally, everyone didn't dare to be careless. If they were together with disciples from other peaks and looked after each other, their safety would also be guaranteed.
Therefore, everyone walked towards the bonfire.
Unexpectedly, just as they approached the bonfire, they heard a burst of dense mechanical sounds.
"Tut tut tut …"
Silver needles, like rain, shot towards Lin Geng, who was standing at the front.
"Pearflower Storm Needles!"
Lin Geng's face suddenly changed. At this moment, it was too late to dodge. He could only unsheathe his sword and brandish it, creating a silver-white sword flower that wrapped around himself. But Lin Geng was clear that there were gaps in his sword flower. The Pearflower Storm Needles were so numerous that it was like a rainstorm falling from the sky. He couldn't block every single one of them.
And each of these Pearflower Needles was highly toxic. As long as he was pierced by one of them, he wouldn't be able to survive for long.
At this moment, only a figure casually floated by and stood in front of Lin Geng.
That person was Luo Zheng.
Luo Zheng didn't dodge. He completely blocked Lin Geng behind him, letting these Pearflower Needles shoot at him like raindrops.
In a short while, Luo Zheng's body was densely covered with Pearflower Needles. It looked very terrifying.
Seeing this, Lin Geng stammered, "Brother, Luo Zheng, are you all right?"
Unexpectedly, Luo Zheng stretched out his hand and brushed off all the Pearflower Needles on his body. He said with a smile, "Don't worry, I'm all right. It's just some embroidery needles. They can't hurt me."
Hearing Luo Zheng's words, Lin Geng, Xiao Yufeng and the others were speechless.
The Pearflower Storm Needles were one of the most famous concealed weapons of the Divine Needle Family. Because they were extremely fast and numerous, it was often impossible to dodge them.
Moreover, these Pearflower Needles were extremely fine. They could easily penetrate the vital energy of a Xiantian lifeform and pierce into the skin, releasing the poison on the tip. It was impossible to guard against them.
However, Luo Zheng didn't seem to have any reaction to the Pearflower Storm Needles …
When Lin Geng, the disciple surnamed Qiu, Hao Shige and the others saw Luo Zheng's carefree appearance, they couldn't help but think of one word at the same time: monster.
Indeed, Luo Zheng's strength was comparable to that of a demon general. Moreover, he wasn't at a disadvantage. Now, he was invulnerable to poison and completely ignored the Pearflower Storm Needles. He was a living monster!
After brushing off all the Pearflower Needles on his body, Luo Zheng continued to open the path in front of him, walking towards the bonfire.
Before Luo Zheng could get close, he heard a feminine voice, "Stop!"
